Friend, Black Americans fought for generations to secure meaningful political representation. **Today, that hard-won progress is being dismantled district by district.** Last month, Tennessee Republicans approved congressional maps that split Memphis — a city that is 63% Black — across three majority-white districts, effectively eliminating the state's only Black-majority congressional district. And just this week, the Supreme Court allowed Alabama to use a congressional map that a lower court found intentionally discriminated against Black voters. The decision means Alabama voters will cast ballots under a map that federal courts determined unlawfully diluted Black voting strength — another reminder that the protections once guaranteed by the Voting Rights Act are becoming increasingly fragile. **This is about more than maps.** It's about whether Black communities can elect leaders who understand their challenges and will fight for investments in schools, healthcare, jobs, and economic opportunity. It's about whether our democracy reflects voters — or politicians who manipulate district lines to protect their own power. Voting Rights Fund is working to expose voter suppression, elevate threats that too often go unnoticed, and mobilize supporters to defend fair representation before more communities lose their political voice. **But we can’t do this work without people like you.** **[Will you make an urgent contribution today to help us defend democracy, protect voting rights, and ensure Black voters across name: Sharice Davids
subject: I’m the first LGBTQ+ Native American woman ever elected to Congress
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
I couldn’t be more proud to serve as one of just a handful of openly LGBTQ+ voices in Congress
| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/111044?t=6&akid=24832%2E878179%2EW5pM6p) Happy Pride Month, folks!

Congresswoman Sharice Davids here — Voter Protection Project told me I could reach out with a special message for Pride.

I’m proud to be the first openly LGBTQ+ Native American woman ever elected to Congress.

I’m proud that I’ve broken the mold of what a typical background is for a member of Congress.

And I’m proud to work my heart out every single day to fight back against discrimination and injustice.

[If you’re with me in this fight, then I am humbly asking you to chip in a split donation between my campaign in must-win Kansas’ 3rd and the Voter Protection Project — because, truly, there is so much on the line in this year’s election, including the fundamental freedom to live who we are, openly and proudly.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/111044?t=7&akid=24832%2E878179%2EW5pM6p) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Sharice Davids and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $7 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/111045?t=8&akid=24832%2E878179%2EW5pM6p)

I couldn’t be more proud to serve as one of just a handful of openly LGBTQ+ voices in Congress.

**But things aren’t easy right now. Not in Congress. Not anywhere else.**

Today, National Republicans are more emboldened than ever to treat LGBTQ+ kids as political pawns, to fear-monger about our community, and put LGBTQ+ Americans in danger just to score cheap political points.

**But if there’s one thing I know, it’s this:** I’ve seen the persistence and determination of the LGBTQ+ community. And I know we can keep pushing our country forward, despite all the forces trying to drag us backwards.

[Now, I’m asking you to join me in that fight — not for my own sake, but for your neighbors, your loved ones, and millions of LGBTQ+ Americans across the country who deserve leaders willing to stand up for them. Please, will you chip in $25, $5, even $1 — split between our campaign and Voter Protection Project — to help us keep up the fight in Washington?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/111044?t=13&akid=24832%2E878179%2EW5pM6p)

Thank you so much for your support, and Happy Pride!

\- Sharice

**I need 10,000 signatures urging Congress to overturn** _**Citizens United**_** -- and I need yours to be one of them.**
I'll get into it more below, but first, I have to ask: **[Can I count on your signature?](https://substack.com/redirect/b6efe648-35d9-4253-a1dd-42c1b896241c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ SIGN THE PETITION](https://substack.com/redirect/b6efe648-35d9-4253-a1dd-42c1b896241c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
On January 6th, 2021, I stood inside the United States Capitol while a violent mob tried to tear our democracy apart.
I didn't back down then, and I'm not backing down now.
But the threat to our democracy didn't start _or_ end that day.
In 2010, the Supreme Court ruled that corporations have the same free speech rights as people -- _which means they can spend unlimited money to influence elections._
That opened the floodgates to super PACs and dark money groups. And they've been wide open ever since.
Dark money donors are already flooding this race with over $5 MILLION to boost my opponents and drown out the voices of everyday Marylanders.
* They don't have to tell you their names.
* They don't have to answer to anyone.
* They just have to write the check.

I spent my career protecting people. That's still what I'm doing. And right now, I'm asking you to stand with me against the corruption that's rigging our system from the inside.
**[So please, sign my petition urging Congress to Overturn](https://substack.com/redirect/b6efe648-35d9-4253-a1dd-42c1b896241c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** _**[Citizens United](https://substack.com/redirect/b6efe648-35d9-4253-a1dd-42c1b896241c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_**[and end unlimited dark money in politics before it's too late:](https://substack.com/redirect/b6efe648-35d9-4253-a1dd-42c1b896241c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Thanks for speaking out,
Harry Dunn

subject: The silence wasn’t just awkward. It was damning.

body:
| Last night made one thing crystal clear.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=9849%2E5257348%2EiAutQH)
Derek, Last night, I stood on the Senate floor and asked my Republican colleagues a simple question: Who among you thinks Trump's slush fund is a good idea? **_Silence._** Not a single Republican senator spoke up in defense of a scheme that would funnel billions of taxpayer dollars to January 6th rioters, cop beaters, and election deniers. They couldn't defend it — because it is indefensible. So I gave them a chance to do the right thing. I offered an amendment to shut it down. **_While 5 Republicans crossed the aisle to vote for my amendment, the vast majority of them refused to vote their conscience._** Ultimately the amendment was unable to reach the 60 vote threshold and didn’t pass. | [DONATE](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=q22026_abs_em.dQeZoR&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20260605_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=9849%2E5257348%2EiAutQH)
---
That tells you everything you need to know about where the Republican Party stands today. The party as a whole refuses to defend Trump’s excessively corrupt behavior. But when it comes time to actually stopping him, **_they are frozen in place._**
Simply too scared to cross this corrupt president.
And so they become complicit. In the corruption. In the cover-up. In a plan that rewards the very people who beat police officers with flagpoles and tried to overturn a free and fair election.
Derek, last night illustrated something we must all acknowledge: if there is to be any stopping the corruption, Democrats must retake the Senate majority in November. That is the only way to truly stop what is happening.
That's why I'm asking for your support today. Not tomorrow. Now.

**Breaking: Xavier Becerra is the Democratic nominee for California’s Governor race.**

# [The American Dream Didn't Disappear](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=7534176&post_id=200791318&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjAwNzkxMzE4LCJpYXQiOjE3ODA3MTMxMjAsImV4cCI6MTc4MzMwNTEyMCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTc1MzQxNzYiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.vvH3f4wW5B4QWi40P4_N4H1fl2zoqNjZwZSn354pREc)
### It was chipped away, piece by piece, while politicians looked the other way.
Jun 6
---

---
| | | [](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=7534176&post_id=200791318&utm_source=substack&isFreemail=true&submitLike=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjAwNzkxMzE4LCJyZWFjdGlvbiI6IuKdpCIsImlhdCI6MTc4MDcxMzEyMCwiZXhwIjoxNzgzMzA1MTIwLCJpc3MiOiJwdWItNzUzNDE3NiIsInN1YiI6InJlYWN0aW9uIn0.8UOgFmh3mg94LQy7gQ0iin3R0rXCe6OOKDx9ZyHhxKg&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=email-reaction&r=1hvr60)

| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/mikefortennessee/p/the-american-dream-didnt-disappear?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

We have all heard the phrase and seen the imagery. Picket fence, a loving partner, maybe a dog and a kid or two. It was all symbolic. It meant that where you started didn't determine where you ended up. That hard work, grit, and refusal to quit could carry you further than privilege or pedigree. That this country gave people a genuine shot at building something real.
I lived that dream. My wife and I both came up through dangerous circumstances that could have buried us. Abuse. Addiction. Crime. The kind of hardship that doesn't make it into campaign brochures. We fought our way out because we refused to stay down, and I built a career from nothing in the music industry. Grammy-nominated albums. Sold-out world tours. A life constructed brick by brick with the help of my family, friends, and neighbors who believed in the same dream.
**But here 's the truth that dream never told me:** the system was quietly being redesigned while people like us were busy surviving it. The ladders were being pulled up, and the politicians who were supposed to protect that dream were busy protecting the people who no longer needed it.
That is the story plaguing districts across the country. Politicians like my opponent have accepted hundreds of thousands of dollars to break down opportunity, and make the "American Dream" really just a dream.
**I need your help to change that, and bring back real opportunity to our working class.[Can I count on your support, just $20, to keep us pushing to make that dream a reality again ->](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/c9d6b243-c070-4204-80cc-0038a97fa7b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Please Pitch in HERE!](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/c9d6b243-c070-4204-80cc-0038a97fa7b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
## **My numbers don 't lie:**
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/a431abfe-4097-4cf4-a596-87ddf14bebb5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
My name is Mike Cortese, and **[I say the American Dream isn't dead.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/c9d6b243-c070-4204-80cc-0038a97fa7b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** But it's being strangled by a political class that stopped believing it applies to everyone, so I am dedicated to being that reminder.
I'm running for Congress because I am living proof that tomorrow can be better... and because someone needs to go to Washington and fight like hell to make it that way.
_The dream belongs to all of us. Are you with me?_

Mai

[INSIDE JW]

TRUMP ASSASSINATION ATTEMPT UPDATE!

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83318&L=38008&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g/dj1IR0UtRFMzd2hWOCZ1dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=18da04d32fd49fa11617bac7407a2c11cf721c14ba69c89c64ac1a1a78263bb1]

FBI RECORDS REVEAL CROOKS’ EMAILS WITH DEPUTY

We’ve uncovered a few more pieces of the puzzle of the attempted
assassination of Donald Trump in Butler, Pennsylvania, but they raise
new questions.

We forced the release of 48 heavily redacted pages
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83318&L=38004&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWNyb29rcy1wcm9kLTUtMDIyMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=3606afab63ca884706873652441947de8d6ec00e54182b5495e17e342e21b3a2]
from the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) through a Freedom of
Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit revealing that a Butler County
Sheriff’s deputy exchanged emails with would-be Trump assassin
Thomas Crooks prior to the July 13, 2024, shooting in Butler, PA.

The records indicate that a Special Weapons and Tactics (SWAT) officer
recovered a “gray remote device” with an antenna from Crooks’
pocket after he was killed.

The records also show that a medic with the Beaver County Emergency
Services Unit told the FBI that she was on the roof of the American
Glass Research (AGR) building examining Crooks’s body when she was
informed that a police canine had “hit” on the building and she
was told to evacuate the roof where Crooks’s body remained.

We filed the July 2025 lawsuit
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83318&L=38009&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvcmVjb3Jkcy1vbi10cnVtcHMtYXNzYXNzaW4vXWFmdGVyP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=640dc1d424a5f8bc2cd14f1dc02ba9ff65b9fa887c6e41dd57c2920b0857af71 the
FBI failed to respond to a July 2024 FOIA request for all records
related to Crooks and the assassination attempt on then-presidential
candidate Donald Trump. The request included investigative files,
interview summaries, reports, communications, media, and database
records, as well as any FBI communications—across all
formats—between FBI personnel, sources, contractors, or assets and
Crooks himself (_Judicial Watch Inc. v. U.S. Department of Justice_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83318&L=35651&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLXRob21hcy1jcm9va3MtY29tcGxhaW50LTAyMjE2L11fP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=c16d098147edc97fe52027deefa95e23eddf421995b70bd09512e2e967ef895f _(No.
1:25-cv-02216)).

A heavily redacted July 17, 2024, FBI electronic communication
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83318&L=38005&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWNyb29rcy1wcm9kLTUtMDIyMTYtcGdzLTEwLTEzLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=f224cd37a44e253a069b4ab0b8800e2f89d9fc4ce9ff5de9f70fac0cc94c5c47]
titled “Disc of 5 Deputies of the Butler County Sheriff's Office
that were conducted on 07/16/2024” summarizes interviews conducted
with deputies from the Butler County Sheriff’s Office. One deputy
revealed that she had exchanged two emails with Crooks. Further
information about the nature of those emails was redacted:

> On 7/16/2024, TFO [task force officer] [redacted] of the FBI
> TOC-West [transnational organized crime] Task Force and Trooper
> [redacted] of the Pa State Police conducted interviews ...
>

> On Wednesday, July 17, 2024, Special Agent (SA) [redacted]
> telephonically interviewed [redacted] ... After being advised the
> identity of the interviewing agent and the nature of the interview,
> (redacted) provided the following:
>
> [Redacted] advised she [redacted] Thomas Crooks (CROOKS) in the
> [redacted] was an [redacted] therefore [redacted] with CROOKS.
> [Redacted] advised she did not recognize CROOKS when everything was
> on the news over the weekend but on Sunday night, a New York Times
> reporter emailed her asking questions.
>
> [Redacted] advised she checked her emails and records and only had
> two email communications from CROOKS and both emails were in regard

>
> [Redacted] advised she did not have any personal interaction with

Friends, early voting for the Virginia Republican Primary begins June 19 and Election Day is August 4!
This is our opportunity to send a proven fighter, John McGuire, back to Washington.

* Primary Election Day: August 4

Americans want peace, prosperity, and common sense, but Democrats keep pushing open borders, soft-on-crime policies, high taxes, and boys in girls' sports. This year it's common sense versus chaos.

Please remind friends to vote. Early voting for the primary starts June 19 and the last day to vote is August 4.

| D-Day, June 6, 1944
---
| |
---
| On this day 82 years ago, thousands of brave young men, American, British, Canadian, and from across the Allied forces, stormed the beaches of Normandy under withering fire. They charged into hell on Omaha, Utah, Juno, Gold, and Sword to liberate a continent and crush the evil of Nazi Germany. Many never made it past the surf.
We must never forget their sacrifice and we must live lives worthy of the freedom they purchased with their blood, to defend liberty, cherish what they won, and pass it on to the next generation. God bless our troops and God bless America!
---
| The FY 27 NDAA Passes The House Armed Services Committee
---
| Proud to join my House Armed Services Committee colleagues as we passed the FY27 National Defense Authorization Act out of committee last night!
This strong, bipartisan bill delivers for our troops and our national security:

* Modernizes our carrier fleet and invests in shipbuilding to maintain our maritime dominance
* Strengthens military infrastructure and housing
* Expands access to quality child care for military families
* Provides a well-deserved 7% pay raise for our service members

From rebuilding America's Arsenal of Freedom to ensuring our warfighters have the resources, training, and support they need, this NDAA keeps our military the strongest fighting force in the world. We have a duty to equip those who defend our freedoms. This is a big step forward, and I look forward to advancing this legislation to the House floor. God bless our troops and their families.

God bless our troops and God bless America! | The FY 27 NDAA Passes The House Armed Services Committee | Proud to join my House Armed Services Committee colleagues as we passed the FY27 National Defense Authorization Act out of committee last night! This strong, bipartisan bill delivers for our troops and our national security: Modernizes our carrier fleet and invests in shipbuilding to maintain our maritime dominance Strengthens military infrastructure and housing Expands access to quality child care for military families * Provides a well-deserved 7% pay raise for our service members From rebuilding America's Arsenal of Freedom to ensuring our warfighters have the resources, training, and support they need, this NDAA keeps our military the strongest fighting force in the world. God bless our troops and their families. | Endorsement From John Fredericks | | == | Thank you to my good friend, John Fredericks, for the endorsement and thank you for having me on to talk the midterms and Iran. == | Halifax County, Four Oaks Restraunt & Launge | | | Thanks for having me! Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | Today's Top Pick (ads) | • | Salem Media Group ---|--- • | Research Boulevard • | Weiss Ratings Plus | | | Market Commentary Disclaimer We encourage all readers to consult a qualified financial professional — such as a registered investment adviser or licensed broker — before making any investment decision. ## Jobs Report Blows Past Expectations
U.S. employers added 172,000 jobs in May, [more than double](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOhCAQhp8GO804i7IWFNfY7bVXEoRR2SBsgKzx7S_sPcIlk2lm8v35_p-HemjnXdi-9UGyrFEFOrOnUiipXFIM2zMuOdErpqKdpey2QAoBxxbqKKudvxRvrFyJkG4NyV7cQXDgom92Ke58Aq0t9rbnRMPNrDgZzmEYJqJBNE5WGoww9gBigA6WhTTeJ6H1aEY7MQ5kXYmpe0YXyk6rv-KbUmfi0Xi5l_LK7PbFcGY4n-fZmbCYemQ4VzTDGT5rYDhXm_ZPpz301daHbi-Hb5K0r9N57_IoGIft0M5_Isq_enlL_A0AAP__fOt0zQ) the 80,000 economists expected, while the unemployment rate held steady at 4.3% for a third straight month. Leisure and hospitality led the gains with 70,000 new positions, followed by local government at 55,000 and healthcare at 35,000. Revisions to March and April added a combined 93,000 more jobs than originally reported, making it [the strongest three-month stretch](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkM2KpDAURp8m7lJcb6UTa-GihsFdz2ZgZilXc9X05EeSdItvP1iv0PDtPjhwzt_38Z2cd3H9RYH7uqQx8lE818p5LDWnuH6kqWTeU67kLBe3Rh4RUEu4Nlpy_hxVY_uFGfnecN-aDowCZdpm69u3WS0Krba2062ZDGCHbFQ7daSXx6Nx_UUDDboFMG9wg2liwu5hiPSs7UMoYOtqyreP5GLdePFn-uJ8m1NofL_VuhdxfwocBA7HcdxCidcncOAoP4vAIaTIp8Bh5ciZvMDhspKB8j-uckopFHm4usnWoAQA-brJWrbSRRnolFTkZ-Sw-3QGjlVuydsiS2WyF5myfD5R_cHNiPuQZmfF_eePKywf5Tfnvcm93Q_nvSvaCAVrIOdfCvVb3b96_B8AAP__5haYEQ) in more than two years. Average hourly wages rose 3.4% over the past year. Economists said the stronger-than-expected numbers make it unlikely the Federal Reserve will cut interest rates anytime soon.

## NASA Funds Houston Space Center Upgrade
NASA has [tapped seven firms](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGu2zAMhk8jbzJoyZHrQUMXb-na0WAlKlYrS4HExklPXzjv3eABBBcS_0d-P6_rFWOK-fYDd7L8DGXNdLREzFTXdkdHjjJTDegoxcCZjlDKqkAZCWetHmN6rWPn7S_w89CRHaZvMI16mnW3WQjBa-_MbAIorVGDGRU6fcHZXAJCF-0ZBgbMMIAeoCc9aQMOtQojhjCLEchHLrXnjZie2EJ6lQfV3pW9S3Zjvjehvwu1CLUcx9G7FN0ftZW_jUs-t4RazreEWlJxmIRaTqZQC7zb5ZxjQ4kHVt-kBpB7TCmWLF3JXNGx5CL34qnm-I_k77LlVrJ8G5IfimTM8pMp1NJV6-_HGdLMJEa47RjT-2L-mueHVf8DAAD__6PFksE) to modernize aging facilities at Johnson Space Center in Houston under a construction contract worth up to $300 million. The companies will [compete for task orders](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u4yAUhJ_G7rD4sSEuKLZJl223tM7CIeaKQAQnIXn7K-c-wpWmmWJG882_y3aBmGK-_oUbWnqFsmXsLSER1q3dwaHDTFgDOEwxUMYeStkkl5rxQ5uHmN7bPHr7n_tVjGiFOXEzK7OqcbeSezEjqGUJ6yrmk5CopVuUXhfpuTFjtEcZ11wLwZXgEyqjNHegZJghhHWYOfpIpU60I-ELWkjv8sQ6uXIbk92J7m1QfwZ5HuS59z5laDBdy3OQ54OGVUwIDQ8LDRh0qL4xVzJVcMRCqeyr7LmVzD7I7IeZxRwqNKoPR496xMdq_b3HlGLTZpj59QYxfWbQ7857WvkdAAD__ypYhbo) covering buildings, utilities, and equipment across the campus, with all funds due to be obligated by Sept. 30. Much of the infrastructure dates to the 1960s. JSC anchors America’s human spaceflight program, home to Mission Control and [astronaut crew training](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHO4yAQhJ8Gd0R4sSEpKK5x9197pbXAkqDDxsLr-M_bn3yv8EsjTTMazXx_vuYvzCWvz9-4kOPvVOeVzr0QM7V53zBQoJWpJQxUcuKVzlTrDAqMVJfmiLl85qGLzqv46Dtyvb0rO2j70N3Leeq96UfU6E3ycLdGDWBHUgpwCHbssrvKlFGm75Xu1Y201UYF1JAGTOkhBkUxc203fhHTN-6pfOqb2i3UpSvuxbztQv8SMAmYzvO8hbru3I7Aua4xv-kKCpiuZ5fhjvLYng0jST7aSk0eQXpqf6nQR_ojlyi55cUXklyPJmC6A6gRBExdc3E7cyl5N1YM6rlgLv-X8M_4vR38CwAA__8iwIYQ). The work aims to keep Houston’s Space City campus ready for the next era of exploration.
## Paxton Probes Energy Drink Marketing
Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton [opened an investigation](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLuO6yAQhp8Gd1jcjh0XFKdxl223tAgMzigELJiNnbdfOa-w0nSj__sv39fl6jBhXr_cEywdsSwZ9paACOrSNufBQyao0XlIGCnDHktZlFADF-ctwWF6L6YL9ibCJDuwcryI0ehx0t3dDoO6TEEJcTP_vDQ-3JQ0PoJQSk5S6Q7tCRODGKQUWooe9KgH4Z1W0bgYJ2YEBKRSe7oDweFaTO_ygtr78uySvRNtjen_TM1Mzfu-94_D5fPJ1Hy2YWr-yJiaN3dQyRzzCxrh6ggad8ll5PmHQ4a6vnmomB-Nnw7cuxgBM_CK7dE4FU4A-SR11YZtx5SwDSMzYn06TJ9E9LcdX1b9BgAA__8sMYms) into Celsius Holdings and its Alani Nu energy drink, alleging the company markets dangerously caffeinated products to teenagers. Each 12-ounce can packs [200 milligrams of caffeine](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuqzAMhp8GtqCQcKEMGe7C1rveEbmJQ6MGByUuLW9_RHXOExzJg4fP1vf__6_zFUIMtPyDFQ2_fZoJXyUiM-a5bGDRIjFmDxZj8Ez48inNSqpeyHNmByEec1c7c5NubGs07XCRQ6eHUdd3AzelL53FAfUFe-3-uFbBONoR2151Dupgzmeyl33bSt3KBvWge2lBK9-B92PVSXSBU274joxvKD4eacfc2LTW0dyZt1Lpv5WaKjV9AGBOmfBYkDBDbJa0V2o6k1VqyhgRCp7rDye-QfFAEhu8OZEAovQki0UE2rFwWIBDImExlvAs4rxYDuFyoIewad2ADrHlxGhZfCzqbNz2CjGG0g9VJ5cVQvxI8--q3o36CgAA__-glJny), a level the state says medical professionals consider dangerous for children, and regulators are weighing whether the labeling violates the Texas Deceptive Trade Practices Act. The probe follows a wrongful-death lawsuit by the family of a South Texas [17-year-old cheerleader](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykULtuwzAQ-xp5kyFLjh-Dhi7e0rWjcZFO9qGKZFjXOPn7wgH6BQVuORIkSH5d5ytQpLR8wh0tP0OeEx4lIjPuc9nAocPEuAdwGClwwiPkPGulO6nOmz1QfM1t5e1N-bGp0Db9oPrW9KOpVnu5mKFrvMbgcMTBOXShuxn0_TD0TquK7GmmOtU1jTKNqtH0plMOjA4thDCKVqEnznvNKzI-oYT4yg_ca5fvVbQr81aE-RB6Eno6jqN2t3K2OHmhp7dE6OmE_l65wZNzkpQeWJgWYMpJQoREMv1ITLgvL-l3St-SEZP0CLwKPVW79dtBMVLpetGq5Q4U30H4f_M9rP4NAAD__8yOh5g) who, the suit alleges, died from an enlarged heart tied to excessive caffeine. Alani Nu's colorful, youth-oriented branding drew the state's scrutiny.

I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground.

Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible.
---
[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=330112d4b80e476f902539c0b1afb118&_e=4egtU630x0nZyzYklhNnASmAced2gFi33VvllNLigLAkh-OoeieA_B0fhdB0v85irEia-1gJHNZ5AkJrkL2iJZtMakvaqcznHI0bOK06vH6zjhDm5CO0aC05NFhfE3Y2Put5pD_2ZSO21y4ZKQFJCC2X8cgAGo0S21YI_U9ApBxcw5BPDRAMliLvlTd5IbZ-tsJN-QOg2neQlvogLSMdI-J0Lpdj_9wnIUjDkhxzg9m8S33PltraT_zm-Hbzmy2zpEKsQjk2UNheaFePuM701kU-6dz-6B6pkfmk-v_a8-jA-5Cc_7q7qNyH8zaLKNrm9tPKmWFHiC2N8-ZHh12VtJCTBYVdPcemJsZRDs1sDCx4hZPvHpPEqCSJhLRTxMasIaEG6iMdrHqxE3yiEPKs7JqEGyOX_9vTvYwlxGBPrmWNvIPVlLLJ7NwG6PBEXjyfwxHw_I5s6X8BJeoEBKAeafJDaiD4hWrsPBJ9d1tWF47c-HHad1ijTBD72y3GkxMbZUexaG7JHmF5JiWPfw_UUozelrjYGAKoybT-XXyvXEsC5luEMMXwxUEB-A34LboBST4wc81k4pFL5DdUD_llBhdVCrw9FlY7bo3zneU5m2j5NZqW2UsH3Xlan4JcRlpgfMq3HDvzSpZI4OTf3tbKBpNOiyMuA4lXytyeXK0kpkNMk4Y0YLSOd0tFz5B-fb_rpr-fm6OBxaAUJSSIKSpoWw%3D%3D)
---
_Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona_
---
These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them.

They're already claimed. And we don't have extras.

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing.

Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. **

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet.
---
[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=330112d4b80e476f902539c0b1afb118&_e=4egtU630x0nZyzYklhNnASmAced2gFi33VvllNLigLAkh-OoeieA_B0fhdB0v85irEia-1gJHNZ5AkJrkL2iJZtMakvaqcznHI0bOK06vH6zjhDm5CO0aC05NFhfE3Y2Put5pD_2ZSO21y4ZKQFJCC2X8cgAGo0S21YI_U9ApBxcw5BPDRAMliLvlTd5IbZ-tsJN-QOg2neQlvogLSMdI-J0Lpdj_9wnIUjDkhxzg9m8S33PltraT_zm-Hbzmy2zCoRML6jdZr9zPSR0gviXE8-dm_QdiFm_ooWck0HMdBfi-4YWSOdEtrRq6A_iyd4zoDimqrkW8cElLo9PTNn5SDT5Gc-UKZINbxWMA-uZUZMjq7PtTp16NfFREFne3LXaKrQVItz7rEHniMzE8QOZY-6vkNPYH0qaFAJf9FBpPp3VtvRFDAaouoJm8sP_odemsjsc-wswpmCMur7NdlGq2nBg5ARuRsh9mpNtEtIizBg3nc469BGvZuByraZ7IkI3J3k88X4SDugbIwmfrDO0J4y3FAOTwl7ax9k8sadDDk5pAt-xI_tiHlrmyCAnxu-h87nZWeaEa9ZWQVKGqvMyoCLjsaHfGxbW6picbb1Ip7cU-0aQ8_mkFDO0zqKuSqCAPCz5lXc9EysYEE4LIMpOrKyl0N9N--I603izEQfO3iFb67sx95pESDTqihSf7Lx8GWtJ3VcHh10Rev1fDtdACw%3D%3D)
---
That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens.

And it's not isolated growth anymore.

**We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. **

But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America.

That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation...

And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak.

So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build.

What's different now is the pace.

**Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: **

✅ Arkansas
✅ Florida
✅ Idaho
✅ Indiana
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Oklahoma
✅ South Carolina
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee

That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action.
---
[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=330112d4b80e476f902539c0b1afb118&_e=4egtU630x0nZyzYklhNnASmAced2gFi33VvllNLigLAkh-OoeieA_B0fhdB0v85irEia-1gJHNZ5AkJrkL2iJZtMakvaqcznHI0bOK06vH6zjhDm5CO0aC05NFhfE3Y2Put5pD_2ZSO21y4ZKQFJCC2X8cgAGo0S21YI_U9ApBxcw5BPDRAMliLvlTd5IbZ-tsJN-QOg2neQlvogLSMdI-J0Lpdj_9wnIUjDkhxzg9m8S33PltraT_zm-Hbzmy2zM5g9bHkkSFu9zsNYY0lvQ7JVzeGPrOd_bhIYKhojLENhBpCoap-DexaDIfJKVLRgeng0Wg5hGFJLS0WqX0N3iOiS6liMZv_7GY0a-UlWOvTsYfGp1ZgGE3zW4Xqkvylwj0N6wkibUchSKhz8eGdrQY4bbkwaa4AwXd5BPefOyOmPRZLHFPpamVEJA6bgwli0ejNNmblwcYvcEI0RIxa2Oh5aNZm4ykXig9HS5J1v8yor7VkvqX-VOig-b4KCPq3MJWjrTpQeDQYvaBo17MG35KJTkXmx15Elld6hX1T7GRX6ftzPFf3PH_A5woUzYm-mQRpyPhkiYd4yEmQWsmEkRNpd-R4gwt1Nis0BewfvVY6pykMlpjt_Hz2Z93XNQFqwzF0UgxJe4pB-EQRF8h5o_EyhAFebw8jSbLDwLAKKN_rdnwHJal8zp4HsiYPBLU7UOtPWRkSE6pv5N8t9TkrPHw%3D%3D)
---
That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly.

It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up.

Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through.

And right now, that's where we're stretched.

We're not lacking interest or momentum.

We're working to keep up with both.

_So here 's how you can help... _

Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it.

**An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: **

✅ Constitutions.
✅ Chapter guides.
✅ Flags.
✅ Materials to organize and lead.

It turns a student who wants to speak up... _into one who actually does. _

And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here."

**[Each activism kit costs $25 to pack and ship to a student chapter. Will you put one into a student’s hands today?](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=330112d4b80e476f902539c0b1afb118&_e=4egtU630x0nZyzYklhNnASmAced2gFi33VvllNLigLAkh-OoeieA_B0fhdB0v85irEia-1gJHNZ5AkJrkL2iJZtMakvaqcznHI0bOK06vH6zjhDm5CO0aC05NFhfE3Y2Put5pD_2ZSO21y4ZKQFJCC2X8cgAGo0S21YI_U9ApBxcw5BPDRAMliLvlTd5IbZ-tsJN-QOg2neQlvogLSMdI-J0Lpdj_9wnIUjDkhxzg9m8S33PltraT_zm-Hbzmy2z6-k-PvrivRLnz10pdHehFNrD32OtbDu24Qj6t62dAHT5zLMhpaWCsyhbBpK5r5nA0cedbEI9v5TQsYtR4OX0U_YtOIK656JwKtixXJKqlBtHxIB-dmALlx2svXETHILhWv04lg6Wln9Os7YetpUy7xBDI9CXG3TQro3Q-B5FKQTOqNtLdf5LzZ0i_hluMKhyc5G0Tu4fcDwfHgLFWSFEZTMEFp1cZODxotphJPd4_GxvDusz4F3E4dpyYeR3r68syZtRVE0b1ggwCBREUhq-YzHOwS8iyf_3teWuEqOmEkhjGNeZ3OyKCgeyBZAELSQ--kVP1Nt-jBDNsuD9Wvx03RfugBGN4BADeH7IE5sv62KhTWsowoERdZqvY12ye-MM_Vp5bKaC5aIc1yQzTx0_-gmv9IYuZtmCHhpbkj5IFBhPVFBRbttG3VZ5i7Fj-TWAUOL30jyiXkFDg0g2btEsmQ%3D%3D)**

D-Day was one of the most important days of World War II in Europe. The defeat of Nazi Germany depended upon the Allies establishing a beachhead on the coast of France where they could land troops, tanks, artillery, and the massive amount of supplies needed to liberate Europe. _A successful landing in Normandy was anything but guaranteed, and failure would have resulted in even more casualties and a major setback to the Allied war effort._
[ Pledge your support](https://substack..Zo4qGzZI60_XUB7q2PUXpoxJKE6nxn5CYkgHHTo1zAQ?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=200874517)
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1454853&post_id=200874517&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjAwODc0NTE3LCJpYXQiOjE3ODA3NDU0MjgsImV4cCI6MTc4MzMzNzQyOCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTE0NTQ4NTMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.94YDvgxtB0Znk7KV-u8V1GIeRFZfT-MGop7aul_mH_Q)
We recently visited the National D-Day Memorial in Bedford, Virginia, and gained a deeper appreciation for what took place on that historic day and what real bravery looks like. The Memorial's location is especially significant. Bedford was chosen because it suffered the highest per-capita loss of American soldiers on D-Day. _**Of the 34 Bedford men serving in Company A, 116th Infantry Regiment, 29th Division of the Virginia National Guard, 19 were killed on June 6, 1944, and three more died in the following days**_. At the time, Bedford's population was only about 3,200.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ee3b10f4-f4e1-461e-b291-6049bf85db8d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
### The Plan
The Allies carefully selected Normandy for the invasion because the Germans expected an attack at Calais, the narrowest point of the English Channel. To reinforce that belief, the Allies created an elaborate deception campaign involving fake armies, fake tanks, and false radio transmissions under the command of General George Patton. While German forces concentrated around Calais, the real invasion force crossed the Channel toward Normandy.
The night before the invasion, Allied paratroopers landed behind enemy lines to seize or destroy key bridges and disrupt German reinforcements. Meanwhile, General Dwight D. Eisenhower, the Supreme Allied Commander, faced one of the most consequential decisions in military history. He needed a narrow window of favorable weather, moonlight, and visibility to launch the invasion. _**Originally scheduled for June 5, the operation was postponed one day until June 6, 1944.**_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c49b2364-e51c-4492-ac2a-2fb7ac39beb7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Map of the invasion area and statue of General Eisenhower at the National D-Day Memorial:**
### The Bedford Boys
Among the soldiers preparing to land were the Bedford farm boys led by Captain Taylor Fellers. In June 1944, the 29th Division, 15,000 strong, received orders to assault Omaha Beach. Company A landed at approximately 6:05 a.m. at a section of the beach code-named Dog Green. From fortified positions atop the cliffs, German soldiers unleashed devastating machine-gun and mortar fire.
Captain Fellers and 18 other Bedford soldiers were killed within the first fifteen minutes of the landing. Three more would die in the days that followed.
Nearly six weeks later, on July 17, 1944, Elizabeth Teass, the telegraph operator at Green's Drug Store, received the casualty reports and delivered telegrams throughout Bedford, bringing heartbreaking news to family after family. The grief touched nearly every resident of the small town.
Today, photographs of the Bedford soldiers who died on D-Day are displayed on lampposts throughout Bedford as a permanent reminder of their sacrifice.
### Landing at Omaha Beach
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c9c8dd3f-43c6-4240-b1fb-d914a6382f3c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The soldiers crossed the English Channel in landing craft through rough seas with swells reaching six feet. _**Carrying between 80 and 100 pounds of equipment, they had no place to sit during the crossing. By the time the ramps dropped and they entered the water, many were exhausted, seasick, frightened, and immediately under fire.**_
Omaha Beach was heavily defended with bunkers, artillery positions, machine-gun nests, and obstacles covering the shoreline. The Americans had little protection as they crossed the beach. Allied artillery and aircraft eventually helped suppress German positions, but the cost was staggering. Approximately 2,500 Americans were killed on Omaha Beach on D-Day alone.
### The Climb to Victory
The battle did not end at the water's edge. Above Omaha Beach stood bluffs more than one hundred feet high. Under constant enemy fire, American soldiers climbed these steep heights to eliminate German artillery positions threatening the invasion.
The mission was extraordinarily dangerous, yet it succeeded. By securing the heights and neutralizing German defenses, Allied troops ensured that reinforcements and supplies could continue to flow onto the beaches.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/220eb4d8-788b-46f7-9036-289f9e19c3ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f2e613f0-1991-4ded-9440-f56116fcafb3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
### Operation Overlord
Americans and their Allied partners paid an enormous price to secure the beachhead, destroy German defenses, and begin the advance across France. At the Memorial stands a symbolic representation of the Arc de Triomphe called **Overlord** , named for Operation Overlord, the code name for the D-Day invasion.
Following the liberation of Paris, Allied forces continued their advance eastward while Soviet forces pushed westward. Together they crushed Nazi Germany from both directions, ultimately bringing the war in Europe to an end.
Without the extraordinary sacrifice of Allied soldiers on D-Day, a foothold in France may never have been established. The liberation of Western Europe and the defeat of Nazi Germany would have been far more difficult, if not impossible.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/49565520-0231-4143-a8cf-dcda9bc05617?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
### Never Forget
It is important to honor the brave men who fought and died on June 6, 1944, and throughout World War II. Their courage secured freedom for millions and helped preserve democratic institutions around the world. We must never forget the price American soldiers have paid throughout our nation's history to defend liberty and protect future generations.
_**The National D-Day Memorial in Bedford stands as a lasting tribute to that sacrifice. Remarkably, it is funded entirely through private donations, gifts, and admission fees. No federal or state funds support this historic memorial. It remains a testament not only to the heroes of D-Day, but also to the enduring commitment of Americans to remember their service and sacrifice.**_

Breaking: Federal Governor to Reopen Warrior Run Electric Plant lowering costs and stabilizing the grid for Marylanders | | | |
---
| | |
# Federal Administration Provides $85 Million to Reopen Warrior Run Electric Plant in Western Maryland.
---
|
---
| [ ](https://us.list-manage.com/JRN6Y3vuuet?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)
---
| | Click the image or this link to watch the Facebook live press conference:
[https://www.facebook.com/share/v/14f73M4WDYX/?mibextid=wwXIfr](https://us.list-manage.com/oVlp8RrNERv?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)
---
| [RUSH YOUR DONATION NOW FOR OUR NEXT REPORT](https://us.list-manage.com/nGc0QfcDFmm?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b "RUSH YOUR DONATION NOW FOR OUR NEXT REPORT")
---
| Dear Dan Cox for Governor,

Four years ago today, on June 4th, I stood right here in Western Maryland while campaigning for Governor and announced our Project Not Forgotten initiative. I warned that under a Wes Moore administration, Warrior Run power plant would be closed. And that is exactly what happened - and not just Warrior Run, but he has scheduled Brandon Shore and Wagner power plants to also close, destabilizing our grid and skyrocketing our electric costs all in teh name of failed "green energy" wind and solar policies.

Our message was simple: _no part of Maryland would be forgotten_.

Not Western Maryland.

Not the Eastern Shore.

Not Southern Maryland.

Not the working families who have watched politicians in Annapolis take their jobs, raise their taxes, and ignore their communities.

We pledged to fight for all of Maryland.

_Today, standing here again on June 4th, we are seeing proof that the fight was worth it. And the Western Maryland delegation and Senator McKay and all those who fought for this deserve credit for their work._

**The President and his Administration is taking decisive action to direct approximately $85 million in Defense Production Act funding toward reopening the Warrior Run Power Plant in Western Maryland.**

This is a major victory for Maryland workers, Maryland families, and Maryland energy independence.

For years, Maryland politicians have pursued policies that shut down reliable power generation while forcing families to pay higher and higher electric bills.

They told us reliability didn’t matter.

They told us affordability would follow.

They were wrong.

Marylanders are paying the price every month when they open their utility bills.

Warrior Run was Maryland’s last operating coal-fired power plant. It provided more than 200 megawatts of reliable, around-the-clock electricity generation. It generated enough power for well over 100,000 homes while helping maintain stability throughout Western Maryland and the broader PJM electric grid.

The value of Warrior Run cannot be measured simply by percentages or statistics.

Reliable power is the foundation of economic growth.

Reliable power is the foundation of national security.

Reliable power is the foundation of family budget security.

Without affordable and dependable electricity, businesses cannot grow, manufacturers cannot compete, and families cannot thrive.

_Today, the Federal Government is stepping in where Governor Moore has failed_.

While Annapolis has focused on ideological energy policies, Maryland families have been left with rising costs and increasing uncertainty about our energy future.

This federal action demonstrates what real leadership looks like.

It means jobs.

It means investment.

It means energy security.

And it means hope for Western Maryland. And for all of Maryland.

As Governor, I will fight to bring Maryland’s power generation back online, strengthen our electric grid, protect ratepayers, and restore the reliable infrastructure that built this state.

Maryland should be producing more energy, not less.

Maryland should be lowering electric bills, not raising them.

Maryland should be leading, not falling behind.

Four years ago, we promised that Western Maryland would not be forgotten.

Today, that promise is being fulfilled.

Thank you, God bless Western Maryland, and God bless the great State of Maryland.

We will win this race, but I need your support to do so. Please [donate today ](https://us.list-manage.com/89jSC7QY_Gi?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)and sign up to volunteer at a polling location near you at DanCoxforGovernor.com.

For Common Sense, Freedom and Maryland,

Dan Cox
Candidate for Governor

Authority Dan Cox for Governor; Nick Krop, CPA, Treasurer.

# [](https://act.alexvindman.com/go/1100?t=1&akid=650%2E3892029%2ENco9Ow)

**Can you keep a secret, Peter?**
[**Today is Alex’s 51st birthday, and we’re hoping to surprise him with a birthday card signed by as many of his grassroots supporters as possible:**](https://act.alexvindman.com/signup/av-em-jun26-alex_birthday/?source=em260606-1&refcode2=650.3892029.Nco9Ow&akid=650%2E3892029%2ENco9Ow)

Alex has always stood up for what’s right — whether it was serving as a Lieutenant Colonel in the U.S. Army or blowing the whistle that led to Donald Trump’s first impeachment.
Now, he’s ready to take on his toughest fight yet: Running for the United States Senate. Alex is ready to cut costs and deliver for the people of Florida — not bow down to the corporations jacking up our prices.

| Conservative judges across the country are writing increasingly unhinged opinions designed to catch Trump's eye, signaling their loyalty before a seat even opens. One opened a dissent with a crude term for male genitalia. Another reversed his long-held position on birthright citizenship almost overnight.
These judges are competing for a lifetime appointment, and whoever wins will sit on that court for decades. This is the endgame. Trump replaces three older justices on the court with younger extremists, and liberals are locked out of the Supreme Court for an entire generation. This is how Trump's America becomes permanent.
The only way out of this nightmare is to expand and rebalance the court, and it does not require a constitutional amendment, just a law passed by Congress. That means Democrats must take back the House, Senate, and White House by 2028 and have the courage to act.
That is what our Unpack Our Courts initiative is building. But we cannot wait until 2028 to fight. This November we are protecting state Supreme Courts in Nevada, Kentucky, Montana, Michigan, and Minnesota and backing Democrats in critical races while we build the national movement for federal reform. Every piece of this fight is connected and every race matters.
Over 100,000 Democrats have already joined our fight. We are building the infrastructure to reform the court right now, while there is still time to stop this. clean_body: The auditions for Trump’s next SCOTUS picks have already started. | | | | If you believe you've received this email in error, you may unsubscribe below. | | | | | == | Friend, Currently, there are no vacancies on the Supreme Court. But make no mistake: the knives are already out. Justice Samuel Alito is 76 years old and expected to retire within weeks. Justices Clarence Thomas and John Roberts will likely follow before Trump's second term ends. And according to the Washington Post, the auditions for Trump's next SCOTUS picks have already started: | == | Conservative judges across the country are writing increasingly unhinged opinions designed to catch Trump's eye, signaling their loyalty before a seat even opens. One opened a dissent with a crude term for male genitalia. Another reversed his long-held position on birthright citizenship almost overnight. These judges are competing for a lifetime appointment, and whoever wins will sit on that court for decades. This is the endgame. Trump replaces three older justices on the court with younger extremists, and liberals are locked out of the Supreme Court for an entire generation. This is how Trump's America becomes permanent. The only way out of this nightmare is to expand and rebalance the court, and it does not require a constitutional amendment, just a law passed by Congress. That means Democrats must take back the House, Senate, and White House by 2028 and have the courage to act. That is what our Unpack Our Courts initiative is building. But we cannot wait until 2028 to fight. This November we are protecting state Supreme Courts in Nevada, Kentucky, Montana, Michigan, and Minnesota and backing Democrats in critical races while we build the national movement for federal reform. Every piece of this fight is connected and every race matters. Over 100,000 Democrats have already joined our fight. We are building the infrastructure to reform the court right now, while there is still time to stop this. But we need more support to match what Trump's dark money machine is deploying: == | | | | | == | == | == | == We can't let Trump and MAGA seize control of SCOTUS for an entire generation. name: Andrew Sypher, Turning Point USA
subject: I have to tell you something urgent...
body:
The real frontline isn’t where you think | | | [](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=c61c8158065c469496900e0c10f55c34&_e=SB54qxrdHIO8Mmjy-uQVxLc0LbT17kJg8r-o3meXcyItHfTkvqaK29u5tswnmHIBbI6ej0ZIedm--YOF11B-oEbHbsR2EHWU3nNCApUnA-lGNwOCVoxZj4C4ofqkR0Xxxo4zwhi1REuMqM0RQAeYaRKbqrgiu-kq-AAQueL9u6J0e52u1p3DBkRQ3ROba9QJjm1OdPa9Nr_2xhTVrC-4rNqYqjQgwTTtbpna8fxb-GxpWA-rxckml11oeFMhqlqHWUFecYFaAGgConqHnFYIXUq25pK81Xv17MLdXYkZpbDtISOvbwrw11VJpXMu5y-bNAesg9op_1KOSVgStZO9PD-6r5Y5Kb6V5zID3Dp-18GDBeHVOQQ-XYQ1djrvQez0ep1e4xEXe4KcAZm9_Gis4EuZAtwyCW4djq69nWpjelysj4CSrKIXok0PNn9HR78vFF0aRZvSMiJG2ddbeTC4-kZtb9Wz5WGTumqfrW4uYmjz8tfpNl_SvhaMyoaFKNl6W3G8otbtlsobQ_m_3VLymTNnoHnwRFZF1XtUlUqsXqoZAjrtyC3ncZUPZHeTJXvnDyIgri7p8QU1qFzqfhJQWwg4snsQy0OEw-e-PLvu0EJHt_rI_CwSlX7mcSdiC0EcqF2_9qy2fzs18fh40k_W2GoCZM0VB4zM7TWDH44qtuv6phpK7xGzWQ0sVKjOylBiXQbQqpQcQedfHS0n4JU5sg%3D%3D)
---
| | Fellow Patriot,
---
I'm going to be blunt with you.

We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit.

Not someday. Not "if things keep going this way."

Right now.

And the scariest part?

It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms.

High schools. Colleges.

Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped.

If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: _" What happened to this country?" _

You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly.

Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything...

The other side is doing something far more dangerous.

They're raising the next generation.

Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places.

That's how countries are lost.

Slowly. Then all at once.

But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope...

There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged.

_And it shouldn 't even exist. _

**Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.**
That alone felt like a miracle.

Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have.

Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down.

And yet...

_They stepped up anyway. _

About that time, Charlie called me.

He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent.

"Andrew, we've got to move faster."

I told him we were. He stopped me.

"No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I actually laughed.

"Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said. "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000."

I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools.

We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet.

But Charlie wasn't fazed.

_" We'll figure it out." _

That was him.

He didn't wait for perfect conditions.

Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... _we lose everything. _

And now?

Less than a year later...
---
[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=c61c8158065c469496900e0c10f55c34&_e=SB54qxrdHIO8Mmjy-uQVxLc0LbT17kJg8r-o3meXcyItHfTkvqaK29u5tswnmHIBbI6ej0ZIedm--YOF11B-oEbHbsR2EHWU3nNCApUnA-lGNwOCVoxZj4C4ofqkR0Xxxo4zwhi1REuMqM0RQAeYaRKbqrgiu-kq-AAQueL9u6J0e52u1p3DBkRQ3ROba9QJjm1OdPa9Nr_2xhTVrC-4rNqYqjQgwTTtbpna8fxb-GxpWA-rxckml11oeFMhqlqHukstycGBdkn1v3229qJ4Fl3ezU6J0AxbXWyhNtXGn_AduwAPb5xgTkmbQaHIcw6MpHYB_oLr0hK7SdRu5euxRZ-UiFeGC_l__S2l463lB1ge-kiLpf2iaTN3OWHfg-ae94L44Mhhx6vBqTw-P4pRFfOtWoN9ZoFC_F1Q5ytzBpdtUpNTTCx61voBtSHc502hlnBKeitG9rEm4iIOCMaKKYUmUrsWzqQGAczGqZo3uGLBNxhMdcyo6zJvdl1a6wC1MZFzGXnGAlsUAHOn63KCnjVcRE6NHNFIvAICeG5otudv9EywseBznNdAdDwOdDcK4YP_2eNxr8_DlXUuGSZCCdcFKIrzwkJubQUd_Bfrl9zkVoyhmtcXM2QnRRUNQdf4DwFol0ix265LgucAInS_qfqleO10WNMl74sI03luDqn1KqXzB2wWVY2GedBQLuMwBvYjfAWWtL54IdVCOaqv5A%3D%3D)
---
**We 're in 3,300 schools. **

**Thirteen percent of all high schools in America. **

**Eight states are now backing this effort to put a Club America chapter in every high school statewide. **

_That shouldn 't be possible. _

Not in this environment. Not with the level of hostility these students face every single day.

And yet... it's still happening.

_But Fellow Patriot, here 's the part you need to understand: _

This is not a victory. It's a foothold.

_Because in the other 87% of schools? _

There is no resistance. None.

Just one-sided propaganda from the Left.

One-sided pressure on kids who are too young to even realize what's happening to them.

That's the reality.

The question isn't whether we're fighting. We are.

The question is whether it's enough.

Because right now, the students stepping up through Club America...

They're not the majority. _They 're the exception. _

They're the ones willing to take the heat.

The ones willing to stand alone.

The ones willing to risk being targeted just to say: _" I love this country." _
---
[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=c61c8158065c469496900e0c10f55c34&_e=SB54qxrdHIO8Mmjy-uQVxLc0LbT17kJg8r-o3meXcyItHfTkvqaK29u5tswnmHIBbI6ej0ZIedm--YOF11B-oEbHbsR2EHWU3nNCApUnA-lGNwOCVoxZj4C4ofqkR0Xxxo4zwhi1REuMqM0RQAeYaRKbqrgiu-kq-AAQueL9u6J0e52u1p3DBkRQ3ROba9QJjm1OdPa9Nr_2xhTVrC-4rNqYqjQgwTTtbpna8fxb-GxpWA-rxckml11oeFMhqlqHcMdNFUsqS1QkZjfs-30pcjfGfcLAR6wTHUEcI-U_8ZHNNrcNbPKBimoM1mV8Q9Ne1XZ-84YTGG0GevqRwUJR0qv48YJxrVgPZN0z9_ySLOSSw2yJoSutMJuEKJmb3jomJklxRuMYMFnjlt17-Id1ORUb5JpyLnnk2_jAXqIYdgaejQ4e7X4VO0ojD3vLWigh-7d4-jIy14ZFQPcfpyzz8QJVXvpiblHSXcVsw5tNVc00oPohyzOP6zoV-X2Bxte9ekdEyiyuoiuVBSINn59yzy0lWTeByL3rk2HCR11aIASPBg4BPNxeQ_CuMlaNQQvqjB3dPdmzWuVe0cfEPVkXfh4L5dY5IjhITlfRxCYccKSu27lI3iZbzAh-p-GB3wgISN5EMaJDNurkuMKJ-lGrf5jGgUDdOlOnrIzyX5nLFwNCuU5gC0ie4yG2VgG70uXkxIniXjWB-Cp7quCjYuWjSw%3D%3D)
---
And every time one of those students raises their hand...

We have a choice.

Back them. _Or leave them on their own. _

**Because when a student starts a chapter, we send them an activism kit -- with American flags. Pocket Constitutions. Leadership tools. **

Everything they need to actually stand their ground.

Not symbolically. For real.

They've already made the decision to lead.

All they're waiting on... is you and me.

**Each activism kit costs $25. That 's it. **

$25 to make sure one student doesn't have to stand alone against the Left in a hostile school.

$25 to put real tools in their hands.

— A new federal task force to hunt down stolen money and get it back — with interest_

Here's what my bill does: — Mandatory prison sentences for any noncitizen convicted of fraud — Automatic, expedited deportation after conviction — Denaturalization if fraud happens after citizenship is granted — A new federal task force to hunt down stolen money and get it back — with interest Your hard-earned tax dollars fund programs meant to help Americans. Not to be looted by people who broke the law to get here and then broke it again once they arrived. Washington has looked the other way on this for too long. I'm done waiting. But I need your support to keep fighting. | Thank you, Senator Tom Cotton | | PAID FOR BY TOM COTTON FOR SENATE Copyright (C) 2026 Tom Cotton for Senate, All rights reserved.

name: Douglas Carswell
subject: Subject: Mississippi is Winning — and I Need Your Help Before We Tell the World
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/mississippiwins?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| _**If you're not in front of our Saturday email, you're behind.**_
---
| Dear Friend,
**Did you know Mississippi now makes more cars per person than Germany?** Our children do better on reading scores than kids in California? Measured by GDP per person, we have overtaken Britain — yes, Britain — and Japan, Italy and France?

Mississippi inward investment grew almost three times faster than New York's. Our unemployment rate is lower than Florida's. **Over the past five years we've grown faster than Tennessee — and more than five times faster than Germany.** Last year alone, a record $21 billion was invested in our state.

When I chose to make Mississippi my home, I knew I was moving to a state on the rise. About the only thing I've disliked about my move here has been hearing about that tired, outdated image of our state. It bears zero relation to the place I see around me every day. **I'm done with being cast at the bottom of someone's list, or having my state defined by a past we long ago outgrew. Frankly, nothing annoys me more.**

The truth is the opposite – and I've decided to try to do something about it, but I need your help.

**I've started this project —**[**MississippiWins.com**](https://us.list-manage.com/14oQZuiXDHo?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3)**— to tell the real story: the growth story of our state.** And the facts are genuinely astonishing.
---
|
---
_Mississippi is one of the fastest growing states_
| None of this happened by accident. It is the fruit of a decade of free-market reform — a flat tax, the phasing-out of the income tax altogether, lighter regulation and some of the most affordable energy in the country. It deserves to be celebrated, loudly.

That is what [**MississippiWins.com**](https://us.list-manage.com/qP9Av2kYx2M?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3) sets out to do. But before we launch it properly, I'd love your help.

Take a look. Tell me what you think — what lands, what's missing, which fact made you sit up, what would make you proud to share it. Your feedback will shape the final version before it goes public.

And if it makes you smile, please pass it on. Share it, post it, argue about it over Sunday lunch. The more Mississippians who know the truth about our state, the harder that old, tired story becomes to tell.
---
| [ ](https://us.list-manage.com/LSlarQLcJHe?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3)
---
_Private investors love our state_
| [Forward this email to a friend!](https://us.list-manage.com/FkGLrOvdNVt?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3 "Forward this email to a friend!")
---
| |
---
Warm regards,

Douglas Carswell
President & CEO
Mississippi Center for Public Policy

|
---

body:
New Hampshire’s Senate race is tied. And I’m rattled.
Folks, it’s James Carville.
I’ve worked on more campaigns than I can count, and let me tell you: **I don’t rattle easily.**
But this race in New Hampshire? **It’s TIED. In a dead heat. And that should scare the hell out of every Democrat in the country.**
**[💥 Before you read another word, chip in $10 or whatever you can to help Chris Pappas pull ahead right now.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260606_1.YMveXt&refcode=em20260606-1&t=1&akid=7030%2E582294%2EntPE_y)**

He’s got the name, he’s got the money, and he’s got the full weight of the Republican donor class behind him — from Wall Street to the far-right Super PACs. They see New Hampshire as their ticket to locking down the Senate for another decade.
And right now? **This race is neck-and-neck. It could go either way.**
Chris Pappas is our guy. He’s won the toughest district in New Hampshire four times. He knows how to reach voters across the aisle and build a coalition that wins. But he cannot — _CANNOT_ — do this alone.
So here’s what I need from you:
**[Rush a contribution to Chris Pappas today. $10, $25, whatever you can spare to help Chris take the lead and hold the line in New Hampshire.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260606_1.YMveXt&refcode=em20260606-1&t=3&akid=7030%2E582294%2EntPE_y)**

The GOP knows if they take New Hampshire, Democrats don’t have a shot at retaking the Senate. And they’re ready to bury us in negative ads and dark money.
We’ve got to fight smarter, faster, and harder. We’ve got to help Chris Pappas build the campaign we need to win. **Let’s show these Republican bigshots that they can’t buy another Senate seat. Not on our watch.**
**[Give what you can right now.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260606_1.YMveXt&refcode=em20260606-1&t=23&akid=7030%2E582294%2EntPE_y)** Let’s win this damn thing and flip control of the Senate.

name: Roy Cooper (via Cooper Victory Fund)
subject: Just $6, Peter.
body:
It might not sound like much, but our campaign is being fueled by small-dollar donations just like that.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6532?source=&t=1&akid=1659%2E124072%2ET1Yjd9)
| | | |
---
$6, Peter.

While it might not sound like much, our campaign is being fueled by small-dollar donations just like it. **[However, before I ask you to make your first donation today,](https://act.roycooper.com/go/13681?t=8&akid=1659%2E124072%2ET1Yjd9)** I want to explain how your $6 can make a difference in this battleground race.
See, I first ran to represent Nash County, where I was born and raised. Serving my community in the North Carolina legislature meant the world to me, and voters have continued to put their trust in me ever since. I’ve fought to earn that trust and _keep_ it.
Right now though, our nation is at a tipping point. The biggest problems facing folks aren’t unique to NC but are too big to be solved from Raleigh. We need leaders who are present, steady, accountable to those who elect them and willing to fight – and **I still have plenty of fight left in me.**
I’m running for U.S. Senate so I can make a big positive impact for North Carolina’s working families. However, getting there will be no simple feat.
The GOP is coming after me as a top target, pouring tens of millions of dollars into baseless attack ads against me – because they know that if we lose here, Democrats will lose our chance at taking back the Senate majority.
**That’s why experts are predicting this will be one of the most expensive Senate races in history – and it’s why I need people like you to join our movement with a donation today.**
**[Peter, for the first six days of the sixth month of the year, I'm personally asking you to give $6 to help me flip NC and the Senate blue. Grassroots donors are the bedrock of our campaign, so even if you have just a few bucks to spare, it will make a huge difference.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/13681?t=9&akid=1659%2E124072%2ET1Yjd9)**
| | | [DONATE $6](https://act.roycooper.com/go/13681?t=10&akid=1659%2E124072%2ET1Yjd9)
---
| | [DONATE ANOTHER AMOUNT](https://act.roycooper.com/go/13680?t=11&akid=1659%2E124072%2ET1Yjd9)

Roy Cooper

name: Dana Criswell
subject: The Seat That Disappeared Behind Me
body:
I started flying the Boeing 727 in 1998. By then the 727 was one of the last commercial airliners that still required a three-person cockpit, and I sat in the flight engineer's seat. . .

Last week I wrote about Walter Hunt, the man who invented the first sewing machine and was talked out of bringing it to market because his daughter worried it would put thousands of seamstresses out of work. The history that followed proved her fears wrong. The industry didn't shrink. It exploded, and the women who would have been seamstresses found bigger work waiting for them on the other side of the machine.
I've been thinking about that story because I lived through a smaller version of it myself.
I started flying the Boeing 727 in 1998. By then the 727 was one of the last commercial airliners that still required a three-person cockpit, and I sat in the flight engineer's seat -- the panel turned sideways behind the captain, a wall of switches and dials for fuel, hydraulics, pressurization, electrical and engine systems. It was real, demanding work. You earned your keep on that panel.
Even then, everyone knew the job was going away. The 757, the 767, the MD-11 -- all the newer airplanes had been designed for two pilots from day one. The computers had taken over what I was doing on the panel. The flight engineer's seat was, in a literal sense, being designed out of the airplane.
When my time on the 727 panel ended, I moved into the right seat of the same airplane as a first officer, and then up into the two-pilot fleet. I have since flown the 757, the MD-11, and the MD-10 -- and the MD-10 is the part of this story I think about the most. That airplane started life as a DC-10 with a three-person cockpit. FedEx pulled out the flight engineer's station and rebuilt the cockpit so it could be flown by two pilots and share a crew rating with the MD-11. They took a perfectly good airplane and surgically removed the job I used to do.
Today I am a captain on the 767. The seat I started my career in does not exist on any airplane I have flown since.
And here is the part worth saying out loud: the industry did not shrink. Aviation has grown almost without interruption for my entire career. There are more pilots flying today than when I started. There are more airplanes, more routes, more freight, more passengers. The flight engineers I trained with became first officers and then captains. The people who would have been flight engineers in a different generation became pilots, dispatchers, instructors, maintenance controllers. The work moved. It did not vanish.
The same thing happened to the railroad fireman a generation before me. The diesel engine didn't need anyone shoveling coal, and after a long fight the job ended. The trains kept running. The men kept working, most of them as engineers up front.
I tell this story because I am hearing a lot of fear right now about artificial intelligence. It is the same fear Caroline Hunt had about the sewing machine, and the same fear the locomotive firemen had about the diesel engine, and the same fear my own union once had about the two-pilot cockpit. It is an honest fear. It is usually wrong.
I seat I began my career in disappeared, but I gained the seat at the front of the airplane. That is what change has almost always looked like, if you stay in your seat long enough to fly through it.

body:
At least 175 people died in the strike on the school in Minab
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2258%2E791427%2EgO0KyZ)
Friend, Secretary of War Pete Hegseth is a war criminal who should have never had the job in the first place.
[**If that’s all you need to hear, sign my petition calling for him to be removed from office. Otherwise, please read on:**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em_hegseth_pet_jun26/?source=em260606-1-180&refcode2=2258.791427.gO0KyZ&akid=2258%2E791427%2EgO0KyZ)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em_hegseth_pet_jun26/?source=em260606-1-180&refcode2=2258.791427.gO0KyZ&akid=2258%2E791427%2EgO0KyZ)**
Friend, I’m not going to just let this go.
On the first day of Trump’s reckless, needless war of aggression against Iran, the US military — under the command of the wholly unqualified Pete Hegseth — struck a primary school in Minab, Iran with a powerful missile.
**At least 175 people died in the strike, mostly young children.**
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em_hegseth_pet_jun26/?source=em260606-1-180&refcode2=2258.791427.gO0KyZ&akid=2258%2E791427%2EgO0KyZ)
I can’t even imagine sending my child to school one day, never to see them again. Just think of the thousands of people — parents, teachers, siblings, aunts, uncles, cousins, friends — who lost someone dear to them that day for no reason other than a delusional man in the Oval Office thousands of miles away decided to start a completely dumb war.
Whether or not this strike was a “mistake,” as the administration claims, really doesn’t matter. Failing to take proper precautions to avoid civilian casualties _**is a war crime**_ in and of itself.
And this isn’t Pete Hegseth’s first time committing war crimes.
Over 200 people have been executed by US forces striking boats in the Caribbean under Hegseth’s command. No due process. No direct threat to the US. No confirmation that the people in the boats are combatants. In fact, many of these boats turned out to be carrying fishermen and laborers.
Hegseth even personally ordered that US commanders “kill everybody” on board these boats, including survivors — a clear war crime.
**If this administration won’t abide by international law, then it’s up to us to push for consequences for these criminals.**
That’s why I’m reaching out today — I’m asking you to add your name to my petition calling for Pete Hegseth to be removed from his post and face accountability.
[**Add your name today and help us show grassroots support for removing Pete Hegseth as Secretary of War. He’s an incompetent, unqualified, and dangerous man who has been responsible for killing hundreds, if not thousands, of civilians. Justice must come.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em_hegseth_pet_jun26/?source=em260606-1-180&refcode2=2258.791427.gO0KyZ&akid=2258%2E791427%2EgO0KyZ)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em_hegseth_pet_jun26/?source=em260606-1-180&refcode2=2258.791427.gO0KyZ&akid=2258%2E791427%2EgO0KyZ)**
The American people are sick and tired of warmongering leaders in Washington who have no problem blowing trillions of dollars on needless wars, death, and destruction.
That money would be better spent here at home, repairing and improving lives rather than destroying them. That idea is central to this movement, and why we must always fight for accountability in the face of endless wars.
In solidarity,
Ilhan Omar
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em_hegseth_pet_jun26/?source=em260606-1-180&refcode2=2258.791427.gO0KyZ&akid=2258%2E791427%2EgO0KyZ)**
