* **Expand** the circulation of _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale College's digest of liberty, to reach millions of Americans (you can also receive a free subscription to _Imprimis_ ...for life--**[click to learn more](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyskd-KozAUh58m3ikxsWovvCjrCAudlmUH9jKcJicaiEaS43T69ovDdNkHGMhNzp_fB9_586pewXm3jBeYsaMPG5RB4zQQGrXgPXkkwqg0erxFIBQH_kCI6e5oosklJbioc76__zbLzHQ3bo5lhl3ZtLyp21aW2dSVFde6BZDW1GWt0YK11h6sqAw2UOrMdXsgr3ldtpyLtpD6UDXQHBvTHG8aGlZxNI5CLGhCwg9I1j_CO8ZChznz3US0JiZPTAxMDAn1FtEUk_M-GfBYoNmYGP79mRhuSOmRx5BSbj2MuQ4-LA58DjNGp4HJIWkme84PbX3hohLnU9Vf-5eX30zUG80qhS1qZLJfY0granLL-NWa0bhtZrLHGZz_KmqYV3DjwmT_CVc7XO3w50BYCBdisv9xPV8vP09n9avJ396Ga_7Uk8XOrHfnvUv1LmXc8z8d0Hfe8b0TfwMAAP__dHG5JQ)**).
* **Send** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to schools and individuals.
* **Increase** enrollment in Hillsdale's free online courses such as **" Colonial America: From Wilderness to Civilization."**
* **Launch** Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 schools that teach thousands of students nationwide.

You should also be aware that...

To maintain its independence, Hillsdale College does all of this work while refusing EVERY PENNY of government funding, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. NOT. ONE. PENNY--to stand free and independent.

With your tax-deductible gift of **$76 or more today** to support Hillsdale's educational outreach, you'll receive a **3 ft x 5 ft Betsy Ross Flag** --a symbol of the American Revolution to display at your home to celebrate our nation's 250th anniversary.

**Supplies are limited, so please make your most generous gift right away using this secure link:**

[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/betsy-ross-flag-colonial-america**](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyskd-KozAUh58m3ikxsWovvCjrCAudlmUH9jKcJicaiEaS43T69ovDdNkHGMhNzp_fB9_586pewXm3jBeYsaMPG5RB4zQQGrXgPXkkwqg0erxFIBQH_kCI6e5oosklJbioc76__zbLzHQ3bo5lhl3ZtLyp21aW2dSVFde6BZDW1GWt0YK11h6sqAw2UOrMdXsgr3ldtpyLtpD6UDXQHBvTHG8aGlZxNI5CLGhCwg9I1j_CO8ZChznz3US0JiZPTAxMDAn1FtEUk_M-GfBYoNmYGP79mRhuSOmRx5BSbj2MuQ4-LA58DjNGp4HJIWkme84PbX3hohLnU9Vf-5eX30zUG80qhS1qZLJfY0granLL-NWa0bhtZrLHGZz_KmqYV3DjwmT_CVc7XO3w50BYCBdisv9xPV8vP09n9avJ396Ga_7Uk8XOrHfnvUv1LmXc8z8d0Hfe8b0TfwMAAP__dHG5JQ)

When you display your Betsy Ross Flag, it will remind you--and show others--of the debt we owe to America's Founders, the liberty you help preserve today, and the celebration ahead for our nation's 250th anniversary.

Thank you for defending liberty through education.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

**P.S. When you claim your 3 ft x 5 ft Betsy Ross Flag with your tax-deductible gift of $76 or more,** you're doing more than remembering America's founding as we approach our nation's 250th anniversary--you're making sure millions of young people learn the truth about our history.

Voter Action Project[https://voteractionproject.org/]
After the House passed the SAVE America Act (the latest version of the anti-voting SAVE Act), the Senate is all we have left to stop this suppressive legislation from becoming law ahead of the midterm elections, folks.

Defenders of voting rights know that non-citizen voting is already illegal, extremely rare, and that this bill is written in a way that could disenfranchise millions of eligible women across the country. Here's Colorado Senator Michael Bennet on the impact of these bills:
(Image of Michael Bennet speaking on the Senate floor) [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA007/1/89215/images/SAVE_MB.jpg]
Opponents of voting rights in Congress -- and in the White House -- favor this bill because they know it could suppress millions of eligible voters, changing the composition of the electorate and potentially empowering them and their party for years to come.

We know the SAVE Act was fast-tracked by opponents of voting rights to be in place before the next election, folks. This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote, and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law.
If you missed it: This bill would force every voter to present proof of citizenship to register, either a passport or a birth certificate that matches their current first and last name -- something millions of eligible American women don’t have. And that’s the point.
The bill would also obliterate popular methods of voter registration for all voters, including:
* Registration by mail

* 3rd party voter registration drives

* Online voter registration in states that allow it

* Automatic voter registration
Some estimates say that this bill could disenfranchise anywhere from 11 million to 65 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities.
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights. “ It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”

body:
I am proud to be the Democratic nominee for Governor for the great state of New Mexico.

| | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/1102?refcode=jtk870-fr-nd&t=1&akid=10162%2E400544%2Eccc7Vr)
---
Friend, it’s a great week to be a New Mexican. ☀️

Our victory this week shows that a better New Mexico is possible. A New Mexico where every family can access healthcare no matter where they live. A New Mexico where our schools are strong, our childcare and housing are affordable, our small businesses are supported, and our communities are safe. [**A New Mexico for all New Mexicans: That’s what’s at stake in this election.**](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/10403?refcode=jtk870-fr-nd&t=2&akid=10162%2E400544%2Eccc7Vr)
| | [CHIP IN NOW](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/10403?refcode=jtk870-fr-nd&t=3&akid=10162%2E400544%2Eccc7Vr)
---
I know firsthand the struggles that so many New Mexicans face. I’m a single mom. I’ve lived paycheck to paycheck. I survived off of SNAP and WIC. I’m over 35 years sober. I started school later in life and paid my own way. But with the grit, creativity, and persistence that New Mexicans understand, I know we can build and deliver on this vision for New Mexico, together.

**But let me be clear: Our fight is far from over. The general election is already underway, and national Republicans are watching New Mexico closely. Fox News has already called this race a top pick-up opportunity for the GOP, and history shows the Governor’s office here has often flipped every eight years. Republicans will spend millions trying to turn New Mexico red and bring their extremist agenda to our state.**
That means we cannot let up for a single moment between now and November.

[**With so much at stake in this race — healthcare, childcare, affordability, the safety of our communities — we cannot afford to sit back and wait. I know what it takes to win in November — but I can’t do it alone. So please, will you chip in to help me hit our first $50,000 general election goal, win this November, and keep New Mexico blue?**](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/10403?refcode=jtk870-fr-nd&t=4&akid=10162%2E400544%2Eccc7Vr)

name: Dennis Price, Heroes for Humanity
subject: This is the moment most people never see
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Heroes for Humanity
body:
A girl named "Abby" was missing. Her mother had done everything right and was getting nowhere.

| | | | | |
---
[ ](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=e21e81cc650244ffa06cc0eb23f4d4ef&_e=XEovcY6K4RoS8uxxWO66LnLTELjNf-uKt-MLvVRtjaK0_U1gBB34zQSU5Rv4Y49ophX9NeFQ7SIo2bcEaqYziFxS7UAhldg-ToOGi5WCrrsk40RNYJ4-UmnUA79c2uPIP6YeKWrmVbnnTs4BDRPIlXIQkiNjVWEMCfYxP8jyRgzViwD3_3SRHVgUVL151E8tWr0iPwQfqWW0yiaSP_HOfIEvCTmJoV87vuZVf0GhhV2QigTMUSINNhGj4AEOdb-rJMfuqCcVI9Et1iFNAeOSfDLF7_CT-39cKagLiJvk5AWDWWTb7EBN3RJh7fwDqmB2m4AS4JrPJBYwe_YbHISyWyHQkenKqCPl5w7bFCRtcBLJTOq3VN37kemabIXUTmQvrzvMWvzNZaeHptFjjX9vAlPkqK3TucJh7O7OXWhgc-oeKRqeTmlKkX3s-iO6zM71nwBOPnKJlzH6K_osZ_BNLgz-4L0eKDOrLux3BLYhh8UT_rq_frCa4UVkkHX71Pyx0RPiIF3lnFOVx0bGrc0AsaCt0jqA8Cepk-G8p0AH4oR18bbzFtgK1CK5ErGaiAiTh9tdGGSwdRiuBUjEx8VwKaelWx7nBneq82PzWuY8oOl2RzryuF-L1HeVgBe5Sbi7Q2Zbldbr3kokQl00xM3ZwTVS4jJdiNmE5GCF-dOyDr45CJqOjzI1E2SuxAKwnfWI)
---
Peter,
"Abby" was missing. Her mother had done everything right and was getting nowhere. Nobody was helping. In her words, she was flabbergasted and lost, terrified for her daughter, with no idea what to do next.
**That is the moment most people never see, and the moment Heroes for Humanity was built for.**
We sent operators in. They started surveillance, built intelligence on the ground, and narrowed the search to a single area. Within 24 hours of our operator arriving, we had a confirmed sighting.
Shortly after, he picked her up, called her mother, notified local police, and brought her home.
**Her mother said it plainly: without our team, nothing would have happened. It would have stayed exactly as it was, or gotten far worse.**
I want to be honest with you about why this is so rare.
You can likely count on one hand the number of nonprofits in this country that actually go hands-on – that physically go in and bring a child out. Most cannot.
**The backbone of Heroes for Humanity is veteran special operators trained to find people who do not want to be found, anywhere in the world.** We use those same skills to find missing and trafficked children, here at home and abroad, and to physically return them to their families.
"Abby" is one story among many. We recovered **9 children in California in 2023** , identified more than **8 trafficked children** in our work last year, and brought home **three more teenagers from trafficking situations in Virginia and West Texas** this past January. Each one is a name, a face, a family. And each one is the reason the next call cannot go unanswered.
_And trafficking is only one front._ The same operators who find these children went behind enemy lines to bring families home from Afghanistan, stood up evacuations in active war zones in the Middle East, and put food in the hands of a thousand people a day in Zambia – all while carrying the Gospel into the darkest places on earth.
**Precision rescue, humanitarian aid, and the hope of Jesus Christ. That is the whole of who we are.**
---
---
**My name is Dennis Price. I'm a Marine Force Recon scout sniper with two decades of service and 15 overseas deployments, writing to you as Founder and CEO of Heroes for Humanity. **We were forged in the fire of the 2021 Afghanistan withdrawal, when I went behind enemy lines to bring 77 Americans and Afghan allies home. Today we are a 501(c)(3) network of veteran special operators, first responders, and medical professionals doing the work in the trenches that most organizations cannot.
[ **I’d like to ask you to directly support these critical efforts, but I also want to pull back the curtain a bit to share with you exactly how this all works.** ](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=e21e81cc650244ffa06cc0eb23f4d4ef&_e=XEovcY6K4RoS8uxxWO66LnLTELjNf-uKt-MLvVRtjaK0_U1gBB34zQSU5Rv4Y49ophX9NeFQ7SIo2bcEaqYziFxS7UAhldg-ToOGi5WCrrsk40RNYJ4-UmnUA79c2uPIP6YeKWrmVbnnTs4BDRPIlXIQkiNjVWEMCfYxP8jyRgzViwD3_3SRHVgUVL151E8tWr0iPwQfqWW0yiaSP_HOfIEvCTmJoV87vuZVf0GhhV1Q3R4Mg2-rtxR0Yzhl6sd4NEEIoJ1gEyhuAIZa4Xu3qaKCB3Uz_I7q46xgRm7w2Q9CUwdG0_8px_Q3dx1kwsq45rj9xhNH4pOd9vBspvTA-Zpz8P0VcrHY1d9KfsJCWDdyjp2Udmi3rq9xzpmO5YbEWsSwL32t4Tmr226kfcE3LDI_dEYuEaZDAD9S2RG24j7slAA7R-y6gUo5SDP1Ab9BjhfFlkBmVAuC9lhaccrv30iYG_W3t_6r2O9TDIPOdTucqYbrwRglr9rDp1_iZcBIV4gstpnPL0alPlVMxQpilRRHC62qgg3TnYWZ4zMXxnw_e-psnYQIgEQL1vXyJEe-SvUY9wa9txAaidUH-lDx9WnxoawhO3CTnrx4aZPQMC2Hnins7ozVmckedPxXTCwXtGthjNp-Ok95-D0OT4nz6k3dDT1HnTp78z6GebxcH1biXfEa-DGWq3sylQY3FOEL) We've put together a short video, with an intro from my dear friend Chad Robichaux, that gets into the tactics, the operators, and the full story of how we brought "Abby" home. [ **Watch it here >>** ](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=e21e81cc650244ffa06cc0eb23f4d4ef&_e=XEovcY6K4RoS8uxxWO66LnLTELjNf-uKt-MLvVRtjaK0_U1gBB34zQSU5Rv4Y49ophX9NeFQ7SIo2bcEaqYziFxS7UAhldg-ToOGi5WCrrsk40RNYJ4-UmnUA79c2uPIP6YeKWrmVbnnTs4BDRPIlXIQkiNjVWEMCfYxP8jyRgzViwD3_3SRHVgUVL151E8tWr0iPwQfqWW0yiaSP_HOfIEvCTmJoV87vuZVf0GhhV3G3kVCcyFWZMXJCYlXdXUyuh5C22ie8lFmR3UgUYOPjI8X-skMG7fT6NoyE8xgbhrzdANeyaetV-EIsxGjLhIkB14jM-laDnyrDcjXACaHNzUIIFAqC5_6xttbcjTvLzH-y1lpSketlXLDIlzchbB_sCKcmwwDKM9c_2WxL9ojdC57c3e6HaQVaBMZMxql6l18nkhhXlxZ9A1zjAurfbN-GZLvx6l2Yjv3K1c9XAKfnYETgZ4tLbjFJD_NlLOT3LnpP_eLQfZlcwwp7DMkxXOLVMhphQvUQ95qlB2iLXc-cfiN_BdGixKU6BXqrjFjwC6VCEIIe76Px_tzRQF7URe2dIB-pJtm5w4TF97w-JJdn4O2hcAbBuWHYnhG5SyXsrDteYO73nEJcuO8mWsQN8fIcYwZmS6FMwvTU4PwsQoj4WT2SzNKTPH4UGKCeKplZTMCY-wdGEX9IUhna28yNO36)
**And know this, when you give today, you’re not just funding some generic mission. You’re directly funding tangible programs.** Right now, the two that are front and center are as follows:
**➡️ Our July operator course. **This July we launch the next course in our training pipeline, where candidates are vetted under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure and trained in the fieldcraft, intelligence work, and crisis response the mission demands. This is where operators are made. Rescues like the one you just read about do not happen without it.
**➡️ The National Training Center. **For five years we've done this work from temporary facilities, borrowed space, and on-the-fly logistics. We made it work because we had to. But demand keeps accelerating, and we cannot train operators fast enough this way. So we're building a permanent home for the mission in our home state of Texas – standardized certification for every operator we field, medical and trauma training for austere environments, an intelligence and mission-planning hub, and the capacity to train the next generation at scale.
**Long story short, your gift today funds the brick and mortar place, and the training, that puts the right person in the field when the next call comes.**

clean_body: A girl named "Abby" was missing. Her mother had done everything right and was getting nowhere. | | | | | | Peter, "Abby" was missing. Her mother had done everything right and was getting nowhere. Nobody was helping. In her words, she was flabbergasted and lost, terrified for her daughter, with no idea what to do next. That is the moment most people never see, and the moment Heroes for Humanity was built for. We sent operators in. They started surveillance, built intelligence on the ground, and narrowed the search to a single area. Within 24 hours of our operator arriving, we had a confirmed sighting. Shortly after, he picked her up, called her mother, notified local police, and brought her home. Her mother said it plainly: without our team, nothing would have happened. It would have stayed exactly as it was, or gotten far worse. I want to be honest with you about why this is so rare. You can likely count on one hand the number of nonprofits in this country that actually go hands-on – that physically go in and bring a child out. Most cannot. The backbone of Heroes for Humanity is veteran special operators trained to find people who do not want to be found, anywhere in the world. We use those same skills to find missing and trafficked children, here at home and abroad, and to physically return them to their families. "Abby" is one story among many. We recovered 9 children in California in 2023 , identified more than 8 trafficked children in our work last year, and brought home three more teenagers from trafficking situations in Virginia and West Texas this past January. Each one is a name, a face, a family. And each one is the reason the next call cannot go unanswered. And trafficking is only one front. The same operators who find these children went behind enemy lines to bring families home from Afghanistan, stood up evacuations in active war zones in the Middle East, and put food in the hands of a thousand people a day in Zambia – all while carrying the Gospel into the darkest places on earth. Precision rescue, humanitarian aid, and the hope of Jesus Christ. That is the whole of who we are. My name is Dennis Price. I'm a Marine Force Recon scout sniper with two decades of service and 15 overseas deployments, writing to you as Founder and CEO of Heroes for Humanity. We were forged in the fire of the 2021 Afghanistan withdrawal, when I went behind enemy lines to bring 77 Americans and Afghan allies home. Today we are a 501(c)(3) network of veteran special operators, first responders, and medical professionals doing the work in the trenches that most organizations cannot. We've put together a short video, with an intro from my dear friend Chad Robichaux, that gets into the tactics, the operators, and the full story of how we brought "Abby" home. And know this, when you give today, you’re not just funding some generic mission. You’re directly funding tangible programs. Right now, the two that are front and center are as follows: ➡️ Our July operator course. This July we launch the next course in our training pipeline, where candidates are vetted under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure and trained in the fieldcraft, intelligence work, and crisis response the mission demands. This is where operators are made. Rescues like the one you just read about do not happen without it. ➡️ The National Training Center. For five years we've done this work from temporary facilities, borrowed space, and on-the-fly logistics. We made it work because we had to. But demand keeps accelerating, and we cannot train operators fast enough this way. So we're building a permanent home for the mission in our home state of Texas – standardized certification for every operator we field, medical and trauma training for austere environments, an intelligence and mission-planning hub, and the capacity to train the next generation at scale. Long story short, your gift today funds the brick and mortar place, and the training, that puts the right person in the field when the next call comes. Thank you, and let's never forget our mission – to free the oppressed, so others may live. Respectfully submitted, Dennis Price Founder & CEO Heroes for Humanity | | | | "MAKE A GIFT TODAY" | | | | | SERVING THE VULNERABLE. SHARING THE GOSPEL. Hi there,
This year America commemorates 250 years of independence.
Families are gathering. Communities are celebrating. The cultural conversation is turning toward the American founding. And for the first time in years, there's a genuine hunger for storytelling that honors this legacy and explores what America has meant to the world.
This moment only comes once.

HEADLINES: Fighting MAGA at the Ballot Box | Victories in CA / PA / NJ |
Upcoming Primaries! | Fighting Data Centers | & MORE!
★ ★ ★
FIGHT TRUMP AND THE OLIGARCHS - AT THE BALLOT BOX!
Things can feel pretty dark at the moment, but we’re building progressive power
to fight Trump and the Oligarchs.
We’re halfway through the Democratic primaries, and Our Revolution has endorsed
hundreds of candidates at all levels of government and made over 3.5 MILLION
voter contacts!
To stop the worst of the Trump regime, we need to win back the House and Senate
in November — but first we need to get the best and boldest candidates on the
ballot.
[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/35232?t=1011&akid=10848%2E5885482%2EnF7Nvp ]If you can, chip in a donation of any amount to help ramp up our voter
turnout operations to call, text, and knock doors in these key races!
★ ★ ★
ILHAN OMAR HEADLINES OUR REVOLUTION TOWN HALL
This week, over 50,000 activists tuned in to our [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39014?t=1012&akid=10848%2E5885482%2EnF7Nvp ]LIVE National Organize to
Win Town Hall featuring Rep. Ilhan Omar and six of our top progressive
candidates.
Ilhan commended the courage of those protesting ICE in Newark, NJ — and said her
fellow Minnesotans are still traumatized by the ICE raids that killed two people
last winter.
"We went through what we did so no other American city would have to experience
that level of terror,” Ilhan said. She told us she stays positive, inspired by
the grassroots: "We can give in to fear, despair, and hate—or we can choose
love, hope, and courage."
★ ★ ★
WALA BLEGAY VS. BIG MONEY
Wala Blegay, our candidate for Congress in Maryland’s 5th - the seat held for
decades by retiring Rep. Steny Hoyer - denounced the millions that AIPAC,
crypto, and AI special interests are pouring into the race for her opponent - a
data center lobbyist backed by Hoyer’s establishment machine.
Unlike her opponent, Wala signed Our Revolution's People's Pledge to reject
corporate PAC money. To counter the flood of big spending, Our Revolution’s
field team is making over 50,000 voter contacts by making calls and knocking on
doors!
★ ★ ★
WHY TRUMP MEGADONORS FEAR ALEX BORES
As a member of the NY State Assembly, Alex Bores led the fight to pass the RAISE
Act, the strongest AI regulation in the country.
This put him directly in the crosshairs of Big Tech. Top Trump megadonors,
including Marc Andreessen, are spending upwards of $10 million to defeat Alex’s
bid to win the primary in NY’s 12th Congressional District which covers
Manhattan.
“If they win, they go to every member of Congress and say, ‘Don't you dare
regulate AI or we'll make sure you lose your seat,’” Alex Bores [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39015?t=1013&akid=10848%2E5885482%2EnF7Nvp ]told our town
hall audience Monday.
“Right now, the decisions about AI are being made by five billionaires instead
of the American people,” Bores said. “We the people decide how AI is regulated.
But that’s so terrifying to these oligarchs, they started a super PAC to try to
make an example of me.”
The primary is on June 23rd, and Our Revolution organizers are making over
145,000 voter contacts by calls, texts, and postcards to get Alex over the
finish line.
★ ★ ★
HOW WE BEAT MIKE LAWLER IN NY
Effie Phillips-Staley, a Tarrytown trustee and candidate for Congress in NY-17,
made the case on our call that Democrats don't need to move right to win
competitive districts like hers, which is represented by GOP Rep. Mike Lawler.
To flip this critical seat, she argued that Democrats should focus on
affordability and economic security.
“When we speak about economic populism, we are speaking to the broadest audience
possible,” she said, pointing to housing costs, childcare expenses, healthcare,
and stagnant wages as the issues voters raise most often.
Our Revolution’s organizing team is helping Effie get out her message by making
over 50,000 voter contacts in the primary!
★ ★ ★
YUH-LINE NIOU: HOW PROGRESSIVES ARE WINNING
“Even when it feels like we're losing, we've kept winning,” Yuh-Line Niou said
on the call. “We elected AOC and stunned the political establishment. Zohran
Mamdani stepped up, and again we did what everyone said we couldn’t do: We Won.”
Yuh-Line helped lead efforts to tax the rich and expand tenant protections in
the NY Assembly. Now running for State Senate in District 27 in lower Manhattan,
she said too many Democratic leaders have lost the political courage to take on
billionaires and address the affordability crisis.
Despite being outspent, she knows the path to victory. “We won't be outworked or
out-organized.” The Our Revolution organizing team is pitching in to help -
we’re on our way to making over 35,000 voter contacts before the June 23rd
primary!
Check out our other progressive [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39016?t=1014&akid=10848%2E5885482%2EnF7Nvp ]New York endorsements on our website,
including Claire Valdez and Darializa Chevalier who are running for Congress
with the backing of Zohran Mamdani.
[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/38203?t=1015&akid=10848%2E5885482%2EnF7Nvp ]JOIN OUR PHONEBANK TEAM TO ELECT THESE BOLD PROGRESSIVES IN NEW YORK!
★ ★ ★
THE UTAH PROGRESSIVE FIGHTING DATA CENTERS
Nate Blouin joined our town hall to discuss his campaign for Congress in Utah's
1st District and his fight against the massive data center proposed near the
Great Salt Lake. Election Day is coming up quickly on June 23rd.
Endorsed by Bernie, Blouin argued the push for the data center is “at the heart
of everything that is wrong with our politics.”
“It is about corruption, environmental degradation, and how bad things happen
when we don't shine a light on them,” he said. "People feel left behind, and we
need to stand up and fight.”
★ ★ ★
CALIFORNIA PRIMARY: RESULTS INCOMING
We’re still waiting for results from California’s big election on Tuesday, but
as more ballots drop, Tom Steyer is rising in the count for Governor — though he
still trails establishment favorite Xavier Becerra and Trump-backed Steve Hilton
for the top two spots.
Meanwhile, Jane Kim - a former Bernie campaign veteran - won her primary
forstate Insurance Commissioner, an office overseeing a $3.3 trillion industry.
She’s proposing bold reforms, including a public single-payer disaster insurance
program that would pool premiums publicly and invest in community resilience
instead of corporate profits.
Aisha Wahab, our candidate for Congress in CA-14, also won on Tuesday, and now
heads to the special election on June 16th to serve the remainder of the term

Kurt Alme won the Republican primary.

Here is what they are up against.

Kurt is a Montana native who has lived all over this state. He is a former U.S. Attorney, twice nominated by President Trump and confirmed by the Senate. He cut Montana's taxes, balanced our budget, and prosecuted the violent criminals and drug traffickers threatening our families.

President Trump endorsed Kurt early because he knows what Kurt is capable of.

But none of that matters if we can't match the Democrats’ fundraising machine in this race.

Right now, in the first few days after the primary, we need to show the country that Montana grassroots conservatives are ready to fight. A strong fundraising number this week tells Schumer and the left that Montana is not for sale.

body:
June 06, 2026 | Read Online ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h62wgl9fzhw4mwwrzhnhrm7wg/9qhzhnhdmr4e88u9h3/aHR0cHM6Ly9ja2FyY2hpdmUuY29tL2IvMjd1MmhvaDhwNDU5M3M1N25udzd6dGc5OGdnem1hZ2g4a3dldg== )

A quick note before we dive in: we're once again hearing that our emails are landing in spam folders — or not arriving at all. If you'd like to stay on our engaged reader list, just click here ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h62wgl9fzhw4mwwrzhnhrm7wg/3ohphkh3lgxk8wirhn/aHR0cHM6Ly90cnVldGhldm90ZS5vcmc= ) and you'll be all set. Nothing else is needed on your end.

And if you're new to the newsletter, or it's been a while since one of ours last reached you — hello and welcome back! We're glad you're here.

Our mission hasn't changed. The good fight for transparency, accountability, and trust in our elections matters now more than ever, and we're grateful you're standing with us in it.

**********************
The TTV Weekly Wrap Up
**********************

It's been another week of court battles, redistricting wars, ballot blunders, federal legislative debates, and enough election drama to keep everyone busy. In the thick of it, Tina Peters finally had her freedom restored after a long and unjust incarceration — a moment worth celebrating! Maryland sent out more mail ballots, still with no protocol for cleaning up their last botch. California voted, is still counting, and is now under federal investigation, while New York floated adding even more red tape between investigators and election records.

Meanwhile, Catherine is battling a virulent case of laryngitis, Meg took several bee stings to the face, and the rest of the team has weathered everything from car crashes to lost house keys and misbehaving emus. In other words: a fairly normal week. Such is life.

Now, refocusing on election integrity — here's what you may have missed:

In Case You Missed It...
------------------------

( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h62wgl9fzhw4mwwrzhnhrm7wg/n2hohvhvp02ldwh6hg/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuOW5ld3MuY29tL2FydGljbGUvbmV3cy9sb2NhbC9sb2NhbC1wb2xpdGljcy90aW5hLXBldGVycy1yZWxlYXNlZC1wcmlzb24vNzMtMDRjNDc5NTQtZGUxNy00YmQxLWExMDAtYTVlNGVjYTEyNzE4 )

----------------------
Faith Through the Fire
----------------------

Tina Peters is free! Through court battles, public attacks, separation from family, and years of hardship, she remained steadfast in spirit. This week, supporters across the country are celebrating her release!

-->Read More ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h62wgl9fzhw4mwwrzhnhrm7wg/n2hohvhvp02ldwh6hg/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuOW5ld3MuY29tL2FydGljbGUvbmV3cy9sb2NhbC9sb2NhbC1wb2xpdGljcy90aW5hLXBldGVycy1yZWxlYXNlZC1wcmlzb24vNzMtMDRjNDc5NTQtZGUxNy00YmQxLWExMDAtYTVlNGVjYTEyNzE4 )
Read More ( https://www.9news.com/article/news/local/local-politics/tina-peters-released-prison/73-04c47954-de17-4bd1-a100-a5e4eca12718 )

( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h62wgl9fzhw4mwwrzhnhrm7wg/48hvhehme8w7o5bxh7/aHR0cHM6Ly9ydW1ibGUuY29tL3Y3YW9kZGstdHR2LW5vdy1saXZlLmh0bWw= )

--------------------------------
TTVN Live and the MD Ballot Mess
--------------------------------

Catherine, Meg, and Vico unpack the week's biggest stories — including the never-ending saga of Maryland's mail-in ballot confusion. Tune in to the 38:35 minute mark.

-->Watch ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h62wgl9fzhw4mwwrzhnhrm7wg/48hvhehme8w7o5bxh7/aHR0cHM6Ly9ydW1ibGUuY29tL3Y3YW9kZGstdHR2LW5vdy1saXZlLmh0bWw= )
Watch ( https://rumble.com/v7aoddk-ttv-now-live.html )

( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h62wgl9fzhw4mwwrzhnhrm7wg/wnh2hghqp6mlzkt7hx/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubW90aGVyam9uZXMuY29tL3BvbGl0aWNzLzIwMjYvMDYvYWxhYmFtYS1zY290dXMtcmVkaXN0cmljdGluZy1jYWxsYWlzLw== )

---------------------------
AL Map Wars: Round Infinity
---------------------------

Just when Alabama's redistricting battle seemed settled, the courts stepped back in. As judges continue weighing in on congressional maps in a post-Callais framework, the fight over who draws the lines, and who benefits from them, is far from over.

-->Read More ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h62wgl9fzhw4mwwrzhnhrm7wg/wnh2hghqp6mlzkt7hx/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubW90aGVyam9uZXMuY29tL3BvbGl0aWNzLzIwMjYvMDYvYWxhYmFtYS1zY290dXMtcmVkaXN0cmljdGluZy1jYWxsYWlzLw== )
Read More ( https://www.motherjones.com/politics/2026/06/alabama-scotus-redistricting-callais/ )

( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h62wgl9fzhw4mwwrzhnhrm7wg/reh8hohmrzko87u2h6/aHR0cHM6Ly9jYW1wYWlnbmxlZ2FsLm9yZy91cGRhdGUvdmljdG9yeS1kYy12b3RlcnMtY2l0aXplbi1sZWQtYmFsbG90LWluaXRpYXRpdmUtYWRvcHRpbmctcmFua2VkLWNob2ljZS12b3RpbmctdXBoZWxk )

--------------------------------
DC: The Ranked Choice Experiment
--------------------------------

DC voters approved Ranked Choice Voting in 2024, and the courts just cleared the last challenge ahead of its June debut. Supporters call it reform. We disagree. RCV trades something simple (vote, count, clear winner) or rounds of reshuffled tabulation few voters can follow, all on top of serious questions about how the initiative qualified. Another jurisdiction just made its elections harder to verify, not easier.

-->Read More ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h62wgl9fzhw4mwwrzhnhrm7wg/reh8hohmrzko87u2h6/aHR0cHM6Ly9jYW1wYWlnbmxlZ2FsLm9yZy91cGRhdGUvdmljdG9yeS1kYy12b3RlcnMtY2l0aXplbi1sZWQtYmFsbG90LWluaXRpYXRpdmUtYWRvcHRpbmctcmFua2VkLWNob2ljZS12b3RpbmctdXBoZWxk )
Read More ( https://campaignlegal.org/update/victory-dc-voters-citizen-led-ballot-initiative-adopting-ranked-choice-voting-upheld )

( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h62wgl9fzhw4mwwrzhnhrm7wg/08hwh9h25rnp8wclh5/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY29uZ3Jlc3MuZ292L2JpbGwvMTE5dGgtY29uZ3Jlc3Mvc2VuYXRlLWJpbGwvNDY1OQ== )

---------------------------------
Federal Dollars, Future Questions
---------------------------------

A new Senate proposal would expand federal support for election administration and security. The need for change is real, but does handing Washington a bigger role today set a dangerous precedent for future administrations?

-->Check Out the Bill ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h62wgl9fzhw4mwwrzhnhrm7wg/08hwh9h25rnp8wclh5/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY29uZ3Jlc3MuZ292L2JpbGwvMTE5dGgtY29uZ3Jlc3Mvc2VuYXRlLWJpbGwvNDY1OQ== )
Check Out the Bill ( https://www.congress.gov/bill/119th-congress/senate-bill/4659 )

( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h62wgl9fzhw4mwwrzhnhrm7wg/8ghqhohovnw74xckh9/aHR0cHM6Ly94LmNvbS9UcnVlVGhlVm90ZS9zdGF0dXMvMjA2MzAyNDg4NTQ1MTE4MjQ4OD9zPTIw )

-----------------------------
GA: Paper Ballots Gain Ground
-----------------------------

With Georgia's QR code ban taking effect July 1 and lawmakers still without a fix, the State Election Board voted 3-1 to let counties prepare for hand-marked paper ballots — a move that puts the board at odds with the Secretary of State's office, which is telling counties to stick with the current machines. The system can handle the change. The real question is whether state officials have the will to follow through.

-->See the Post ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h62wgl9fzhw4mwwrzhnhrm7wg/8ghqhohovnw74xckh9/aHR0cHM6Ly94LmNvbS9UcnVlVGhlVm90ZS9zdGF0dXMvMjA2MzAyNDg4NTQ1MTE4MjQ4OD9zPTIw )
See the Post ( https://x.com/TrueTheVote/status/2063024885451182488?s=20 )

( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h62wgl9fzhw4mwwrzhnhrm7wg/vqh3hrho7rmq5ksghl/aHR0cHM6Ly94LmNvbS9FbmRXb2tlbmVzcy9zdGF0dXMvMjA2MjQwMzIzMjI5NTQ5NDA4MQ== )

---------------------------
Still Counting, California?
---------------------------

Election night came and went and... California is still counting. While officials defend the state's lengthy ballot processing procedures, voters question integrity, motives, "anomalies," and results that don't seem to add up. Now the situation has drawn federal attention ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h62wgl9fzhw4mwwrzhnhrm7wg/l2hehmhl97qdgoa6h0/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubmJjbmV3cy5jb20vcG9saXRpY3MvZWxlY3Rpb25zL2Rvai1vZmZpY2UtaW52ZXN0aWdhdGlvbnMtY2FsaWZvcm5pYS1lbGVjdGlvbnMtdHJ1bXAtY2xhaW1zLWNoZWF0aW5nLXJjbmEzNDg3NDY= ): a U.S. Attorney in California says his office has multiple election fraud investigations underway with the FBI, and a DOJ attorney has been dispatched to observe ballot processing in Los Angeles County.

-->See the Post ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h62wgl9fzhw4mwwrzhnhrm7wg/vqh3hrho7rmq5ksghl/aHR0cHM6Ly94LmNvbS9FbmRXb2tlbmVzcy9zdGF0dXMvMjA2MjQwMzIzMjI5NTQ5NDA4MQ== )
See the Post ( https://x.com/EndWokeness/status/2062403232295494081 )

( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h62wgl9fzhw4mwwrzhnhrm7wg/m2h7h5h3pz2lr8imhq/aHR0cHM6Ly9hc3NlbWJseS5zdGF0ZS5ueS51cy9sZWcvP3NoPXByaW50YmlsbCZibj1TMTA1OTkmdGVybT0yMDI1JlRleHQ9WQ== )

----------------------------
NY: More "Election Security"
----------------------------

New York's proposed bill S10599 would require election officials to notify the Attorney General and the State Board of Elections whenever a subpoena, warrant, lawsuit, or other request seeks access to certain election records. Proponents call it protection. Skeptics ask a fair question: why should anyone get a heads-up before investigators look under the hood?

-->Read the Bill ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h62wgl9fzhw4mwwrzhnhrm7wg/m2h7h5h3pz2lr8imhq/aHR0cHM6Ly9hc3NlbWJseS5zdGF0ZS5ueS51cy9sZWcvP3NoPXByaW50YmlsbCZibj1TMTA1OTkmdGVybT0yMDI1JlRleHQ9WQ== )
Read the Bill ( https://assembly.state.ny.us/leg/?sh=printbill&bn=S10599&term=2025&Text=Y )

( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h62wgl9fzhw4mwwrzhnhrm7wg/dpheh0hegnd23etmh4/aHR0cHM6Ly90cnVldGhldm90ZS5vcmcvaGVscGxpbmU= )

---------------------------
The Reports are Flooding In
---------------------------

More than one ballot arriving in the mail? Receiving odd voter information you never requested? Problems at the polling place? If your election experi seem right, we want to hear it. We're here to help.

-->Send Us a Report ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h62wgl9fzhw4mwwrzhnhrm7wg/dpheh0hegnd23etmh4/aHR0cHM6Ly90cnVldGhldm90ZS5vcmcvaGVscGxpbmU= )
Send Us a Report ( https://truethevote.org/helpline )

Lead From Where You Stand
-------------------------

The battle over who controls America's elections is intensifying.

Different states and issues, same underlying questions: who holds the power? Who has access to the records? Who writes the rules? And who is watching the people in charge?

These aren't partisan questions. They're American ones.

The answers will shape not only future elections, but the public's confidence in them.

---------------
What You Can Do
---------------

* A call to action: if you or someone you know can obtain the Kentucky voter rolls, please reach out to us ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h62wgl9fzhw4mwwrzhnhrm7wg/7qh7h8h975dxgzczh6/aHR0cHM6Ly90cnVldGhldm90ZS5vcmcvY29udGFjdA== ).
* Help us test the new version of Scan. Check. Protect. If you live in Hawaii, North Dakota, Mississippi, or Missouri, we need you! Contact us ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h62wgl9fzhw4mwwrzhnhrm7wg/7qh7h8h975dxgzczh6/aHR0cHM6Ly90cnVldGhldm90ZS5vcmcvY29udGFjdA== ) and we'll walk you through the next steps. (P.S. — if you've already reached out, thank you!!)
* See something, say something — cliché, but true. Are you receiving ballots or voter-related mail you didn't request? Take pictures and send us the details through our report line ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h62wgl9fzhw4mwwrzhnhrm7wg/dpheh0hegnd23etmh4/aHR0cHM6Ly90cnVldGhldm90ZS5vcmcvaGVscGxpbmU= ).
* Stay informed on election legislation ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h62wgl9fzhw4mwwrzhnhrm7wg/owhkhqhwvdx0z5tvhr/aHR0cHM6Ly9sZWdpdHJhY2sub3Jn ). What is your state doing? Track it all in LegiTrack before it becomes law.
* Get involved locally ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h62wgl9fzhw4mwwrzhnhrm7wg/z2hghnhevx5mg5bph0/aHR0cHM6Ly9jb21tdW5pdHkudHR2bm93Lm9yZw== ). Join grassroots efforts in your state, attend local meetings, support transparency work, and help educate others on the issues shaping their communities.
* Vote! The evidence is clear: when you make the effort, you see the results. Shut out the voices that tell you your vote doesn't matter — it matters!!
* Pray for wisdom, courage, and discernment. No matter where you stand politically, this is a defining moment for the country and for the people entrusted with stewarding it.
* Support our work ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h62wgl9fzhw4mwwrzhnhrm7wg/p8heh9h40orpvmaqh3/aHR0cHM6Ly90cnVldGhldm90ZS5vcmcvZG9uYXRl ) if you're able. Every volunteer hour, conversation, share, and donation helps strengthen the movement for transparency, accountability, and citizen engagement.

Tools for Your Toolkit
----------------------

You weren't meant to do this alone. Find your community, your tools, your purpose.

-->Become a Member ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h62wgl9fzhw4mwwrzhnhrm7wg/x0hph6he60k4g2u5hl/aHR0cHM6Ly9jb21tdW5pdHkudHR2bm93Lm9yZy9jaGVja291dC9iZWNvbWUtYS1tZW1iZXI= )
Become a Member ( https://community.ttvnow.org/checkout/become-a-member )

Stay ahead of the legislation shaping your elections and know when it's time to act.

-->Join LegiTrack ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h62wgl9fzhw4mwwrzhnhrm7wg/6qheh8hlgex3qeaohk/aHR0cHM6Ly9sZWdpdHJhY2sub3JnLyNiaWxsLXRyYWNrZXI= )
Join LegiTrack ( https://legitrack.org/#bill-tracker )

---------------
Until Next Week
---------------

Remember: you don't need a law degree, a title, or anyone's permission to make a difference. You need awareness. You need discernment. You need the willingness to stay engaged when it would be far easier to tune out.

Real change rarely begins in Washington. It begins in homes and churches, in communities and conversations — in citizens who refuse to surrender the future of their country to apathy.

True the Vote will keep doing our part. With faith, with steadiness, and with people like you willing to stand shoulder to shoulder, we'll keep pressing forward — for transparency, accountability, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness; for the America we were given, and the one we mean to keep.

Ever onward.

-->Stand With Us ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h62wgl9fzhw4mwwrzhnhrm7wg/kkhmh6hnqvzo7qhlh7/dHJ1ZXRoZXZvdGUub3JnL2RvbmF0ZQ== )
Stand With Us ( truethevote.org/donate )We can't do this without you — and we wouldn't want to.

Thank you for your support!

-----------------
Grounded in Truth
-----------------

A weekly word from the TTV team. Want one every day? Join us in TTV Now. ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h62wgl9fzhw4mwwrzhnhrm7wg/x0hph6he60k4g2u5hl/aHR0cHM6Ly9jb21tdW5pdHkudHR2bm93Lm9yZy9jaGVja291dC9iZWNvbWUtYS1tZW1iZXI= )

Father,

We thank You that our stories do not end where our circumstances seem to say they should. Again and again, You step into situations that appear final and rewrite the story. When we see obstacles, You see opportunities. When we see limitations, You see possibilities. When we see a pit, You see a palace. And when we see chains, You see a testimony waiting to be told.

Give us the courage to keep standing and keep believing. Strengthen our faith when fear tries to speak louder than Your promises. Help us stand firm when circumstances tempt us to quit. And when the enemy whispers that our situation is hopeless, remind us that nothing is beyond Your reach, outside of Your authority, or greater than Your power.

clean_body: June 06, 2026 | Read Online ( == ) A quick note before we dive in: we're once again hearing that our emails are landing in spam folders — or not arriving at all. If you'd like to stay on our engaged reader list, just click here ( = ) and you'll be all set. Nothing else is needed on your end. And if you're new to the newsletter, or it's been a while since one of ours last reached you — hello and welcome back! We're glad you're here. Our mission hasn't changed. The good fight for transparency, accountability, and trust in our elections matters now more than ever, and we're grateful you're standing with us in it. The TTV Weekly Wrap Up It's been another week of court battles, redistricting wars, ballot blunders, federal legislative debates, and enough election drama to keep everyone busy. In the thick of it, Tina Peters finally had her freedom restored after a long and unjust incarceration — a moment worth celebrating! Maryland sent out more mail ballots, still with no protocol for cleaning up their last botch. California voted, is still counting, and is now under federal investigation, while New York floated adding even more red tape between investigators and election records. Meanwhile, Catherine is battling a virulent case of laryngitis, Meg took several bee stings to the face, and the rest of the team has weathered everything from car crashes to lost house keys and misbehaving emus. In other words: a fairly normal week. Such is life. Now, refocusing on election integrity — here's what you may have missed: In Case You Missed It... ( ) Faith Through the Fire Tina Peters is free! Through court battles, public attacks, separation from family, and years of hardship, she remained steadfast in spirit. This week, supporters across the country are celebrating her release! -->Read More ( ) Read More ( ) ( = ) TTVN Live and the MD Ballot Mess Catherine, Meg, and Vico unpack the week's biggest stories — including the never-ending saga of Maryland's mail-in ballot confusion. Tune in to the 38:35 minute mark. -->Watch ( = ) Watch ( ) ( == ) AL Map Wars: Round Infinity Just when Alabama's redistricting battle seemed settled, the courts stepped back in. As judges continue weighing in on congressional maps in a post-Callais framework, the fight over who draws the lines, and who benefits from them, is far from over. -->Read More ( == ) Read More ( ) ( ) DC: The Ranked Choice Experiment DC voters approved Ranked Choice Voting in 2024, and the courts just cleared the last challenge ahead of its June debut. Supporters call it reform. We disagree. RCV trades something simple (vote, count, clear winner) or rounds of reshuffled tabulation few voters can follow, all on top of serious questions about how the initiative qualified. Another jurisdiction just made its elections harder to verify, not easier. -->Read More ( ) Read More ( ) ( == ) Federal Dollars, Future Questions A new Senate proposal would expand federal support for election administration and security. The need for change is real, but does handing Washington a bigger role today set a dangerous precedent for future administrations? -->Check Out the Bill ( == ) Check Out the Bill ( ) ( ) GA: Paper Ballots Gain Ground With Georgia's QR code ban taking effect July 1 and lawmakers still without a fix, the State Election Board voted 3-1 to let counties prepare for hand-marked paper ballots — a move that puts the board at odds with the Secretary of State's office, which is telling counties to stick with the current machines. The system can handle the change. The real question is whether state officials have the will to follow through. -->See the Post ( ) See the Post ( ) ( == ) Still Counting, California? Election night came and went and... California is still counting. While officials defend the state's lengthy ballot processing procedures, voters question integrity, motives, "anomalies," and results that don't seem to add up. Now the situation has drawn federal attention ( = ): a U.S. Attorney in California says his office has multiple election fraud investigations underway with the FBI, and a DOJ attorney has been dispatched to observe ballot processing in Los Angeles County. -->See the Post ( == ) See the Post ( ) ( == ) NY: More "Election Security" New York's proposed bill S10599 would require election officials to notify the Attorney General and the State Board of Elections whenever a subpoena, warrant, lawsuit, or other request seeks access to certain election records. Proponents call it protection. Skeptics ask a fair question: why should anyone get a heads-up before investigators look under the hood? -->Read the Bill ( == ) Read the Bill ( ) ( = ) The Reports are Flooding In More than one ballot arriving in the mail? Receiving odd voter information you never requested? Problems at the polling place? If your election experi seem right, we want to hear it. We're here to help. -->Send Us a Report ( = ) Send Us a Report ( ) Lead From Where You Stand The battle over who controls America's elections is intensifying. Different states and issues, same underlying questions: who holds the power? Who has access to the records? Who writes the rules? And who is watching the people in charge? These aren't partisan questions. They're American ones. The answers will shape not only future elections, but the public's confidence in them. What You Can Do A call to action: if you or someone you know can obtain the Kentucky voter rolls, please reach out to us ( == ). Help us test the new version of Scan. Check. Protect. If you live in Hawaii, North Dakota, Mississippi, or Missouri, we need you! Contact us ( == ) and we'll walk you through the next steps. (P.S. — if you've already reached out, thank you!!) See something, say something — cliché, but true. Are you receiving ballots or voter-related mail you didn't request? Take pictures and send us the details through our report line ( = ). Stay informed on election legislation ( ). What is your state doing? Track it all in LegiTrack before it becomes law. Get involved locally ( == ). Join grassroots efforts in your state, attend local meetings, support transparency work, and help educate others on the issues shaping their communities. Vote! The evidence is clear: when you make the effort, you see the results. Shut out the voices that tell you your vote doesn't matter — it matters!! Pray for wisdom, courage, and discernment. No matter where you stand politically, this is a defining moment for the country and for the people entrusted with stewarding it. * Support our work ( ) if you're able. Every volunteer hour, conversation, share, and donation helps strengthen the movement for transparency, accountability, and citizen engagement. clean_body: | = The General Election is officially underway. As we prepare for the fights ahead, there's a number from 2024 that we need you to sit with for a moment: $17 million. That's how much outside money was spent against us in CA-45 last cycle – making it the most expensive House race in the entire country. But here's what made that possible: tens of thousands of grassroots donors who refused to be outspent into silence. Fellow American, it's Newt Gingrich.

I am going to be straight with you, because that is the only way I know how to operate.

I have been sounding the alarm for months, telling anyone who will listen that our party needs to sharpen its message, connect with the American people on the issues that are hitting them hardest, and walk into November with a strategy that actually reflects the reality on the ground.

We must not sleepwalk into an election we should be winning and come up short because we were not paying close enough attention.

These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them.

They're already claimed. And we don't have extras.

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing.

Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. **

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet.

**We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. **

But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America.

That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation...

And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak.

So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build.

What's different now is the pace.

subject: A community where everyone belongs
body:
A Montgomery County where everyone is valued, respected, and free to be who they are.

| Peter, this week, I was honored to join Montgomery County's 8th Annual Pride Flag Raising.

It was a powerful reminder of who we are and who we strive to be as a community.

As we raise the Pride flag, we reaffirm our commitment to a Montgomery County where everyone is valued, respected, and free to be who they are.

subject: What I wouldn’t give for one more letter
body:
I read them even slower now... | | | | [](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=39acbe6d3e914f8098e995a2dc967aee&_e=X-kPyCksgcDlhNe8gfzrtBFCo0JcYZA5UqArk8D1AbAIAIY4_vaVW6EmwJQTjjH7Aj8HNbzmCjlZzDAF8wkECNx0XI0Li-3z4jZK_aLicpM6Jb-2cY6KhdsDKpzIge__A5nQl2URSsP70TCCzgw8XZ7nHw40DheW7yA5-FmuACV73JHpurTZj5PiwJXixKX1eBseaospuhFw96NimmGip3AZ0QE8L66NBfNE4zdKP4YjY8fsV5xM-7Qj0yQt7_iwzniv_nUy2sJpv9tItALm1acUTcbdaUSLtXFX6iL14DogsNhJxQyXwIM5pqHdd10kUX7_0mM2bZciCoGvrosjVzXwZFephUJ2VdS3hxamIO2Np6sM6dBW9kBdaR6DebUAopI3RjBN5G0B6jAkv10znlyYcE6CZntJ_3KopQ2GkKyz2gOUnHWvkESlhcL1XWrN2ltaTiS46V4EPUaQn6vLYVhshCHZ8CmBoZjZJYU2gsCOf3c9KuXqHJeCM_dYLofgjkwuZNF4EKqsk18egAJsFW-ZQBQtTzee49zFfejAA1LowGX4DlCcpao1I92Pym_TVQfahQQMkQSRxdIGusKlZd1d_CZY6AQ3IMTB2tHdIDiZs9J-bfdQqhs66KqvH0oMmRArpQ6kTCNfyKG2mQHdQloV-Yf5pO9q8N1GBOUL5D4gFdahMKgNS7zIkuQW4u8RTFeEllvsuY0UG0Zqgp9nDHVYy0bShVCA-3YDYzBBGdWo6r_ZjhH5gmNUpCYYSkqN)
---
| | | Peter,
---
What I wouldn't give for one more love letter from Charlie.

One more handwritten note left beside my coffee before he rushed out the door.

One more folded piece of paper on my pillow before he had an early flight.

One more moment where he intentionally set aside the noise of the world just to remind me that I was loved.

About this time last year, Charlie and I sat together on-stage at the Women's Leadership Summit (WLS), answering questions from young women about marriage, family, faith, raising children, and the kind of future they hoped to have one day.
---
[](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=39acbe6d3e914f8098e995a2dc967aee&_e=X-kPyCksgcDlhNe8gfzrtBFCo0JcYZA5UqArk8D1AbAIAIY4_vaVW6EmwJQTjjH7Aj8HNbzmCjlZzDAF8wkECNx0XI0Li-3z4jZK_aLicpM6Jb-2cY6KhdsDKpzIge__A5nQl2URSsP70TCCzgw8XZ7nHw40DheW7yA5-FmuACV73JHpurTZj5PiwJXixKX1eBseaospuhFw96NimmGip3AZ0QE8L66NBfNE4zdKP4YjY8fsV5xM-7Qj0yQt7_iwzniv_nUy2sJpv9tItALm1TJ7dsjr9XxgWotRbkAIod3xOmb9fKfgCBluJFWr_fzPM1z9829w9veH3gf4bC4SNSuFAfswWOBQApY6FlnpHoU_fJj_FiG0IKKf4SxdOoJA8fYPrxkm45vvPeqhwLopn-ATKAhC4_yqwi4Fkic6MQ9QDaBIWONIUKYeAipOQ2cwZGmLeg0xElwphzOmOBxleksvd831bp-FNkUF2OZFXghb_0-uD8SClJVEBhXvRJ_PH0P0d9ctdd2s7d3yHL0D5pRM2BZ6dHrm8ObtqFadOf13PxH4xyfQBQXLuLykToxFGv-5IcE3UHlsY6Oiki2DMtQHjEDXG5xjVjD61i2oF-5ugEKjgJlXKQVL0Ib0etK6UYVzqm9KzaXLW2-e1OYT5pTfa_iMx0I3HsQLle1XweIaN6igel03rrldM9YYXOygmm6ZtfCnAc7jeFUboSjIa_rCUBG_B-VLaptQtMk9Vr2gD9l5MXxq4E-X104pXOeG)
---
Somewhere during that conversation, I mentioned the notes he would write to me.

They were one of the many quiet ways Charlie loved me.

I shared that he would write them whenever he had a moment while he honored the Sabbath.

_He never missed one. _

Sometimes they were only a few sentences, but they carried such a deep reverence about them. He'd hand me words that felt sacred.

I saved every single one of those letters.
---
[](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=39acbe6d3e914f8098e995a2dc967aee&_e=X-kPyCksgcDlhNe8gfzrtBFCo0JcYZA5UqArk8D1AbAIAIY4_vaVW6EmwJQTjjH7Aj8HNbzmCjlZzDAF8wkECNx0XI0Li-3z4jZK_aLicpM6Jb-2cY6KhdsDKpzIge__A5nQl2URSsP70TCCzgw8XZ7nHw40DheW7yA5-FmuACV73JHpurTZj5PiwJXixKX1eBseaospuhFw96NimmGip3AZ0QE8L66NBfNE4zdKP4YjY8fsV5xM-7Qj0yQt7_iwzniv_nUy2sJpv9tItALm1ZXyIEAnWka3TM038saZYtx1yObMIQVy01aUpIq8--mcdDyBm0fWxDXZ3cGC9x021Jio_R0YnADszXHan4ojY5giPh16K0F8Pyxy1qjND-VmmoYgvFTH2SWp30mT8uFbgVI-u7gjF7yYsSoArpoQPa8wnwaq_Ol2HVoJzjX-SHTB_N49Kpt5-ET5dcTy0cGlJG6uoRxjhfcpjWrOL_6OWEvuX1XAgQkxsehCFS7lQRQbXozkIOWGgTYJdT6QBXR8Wydgxut_0mcFX2pprNmPxh_5eSkna-qrSqW4D7KKyigb_NUXzqG7yW-0Nayh81vGYY4Oh57nRvF4xtnJyq957o8F6qVHxN7jEhXJu9ZoHPTg2ufj2hqL3SYXGTNyRWnsmXn1UT7-79SPyO7gV9IKMcyTUxfGSmYxq6gl0GY02127jnHrVXRMemCe50es6OpSYoRiHVt89-hxoKmd2apagspU5yaANBJ9cS0Q6ieX33F7)
---
Charlie knew how much those little notes meant to me, and now I treasure them in a way I never could have understood at the time.

I hold onto every word he left for me.

And looking back, I think about the young women in the room listening to us that night at the Women's Leadership Summit.

Because so many of those young women were longing for something this culture keeps trying to convince them no longer matters.

A strong family. A faithful marriage. Children raised in a home filled with purpose and love.

A life rooted in God instead of endless striving and the empty pursuit of self.

And honestly, Peter, I think that ache runs much deeper than most people realize.

I see it constantly when I meet young women across the country.

So many feel exhausted by the pressure to chase an image of success that leaves them anxious, disconnected, and lonely.

They've been told that fulfillment comes from constant achievement... endless comparison... putting themselves first.

But as I said last year, the enemy has a way of disguising bondage as empowerment.

I think that's part of why so many young women are drawn to the Women's Leadership Summit in the first place.

Because for one weekend, thousands of young women come together and realize they are not alone for wanting a different kind of life.

They meet other young women who still love God, still believe family matters, and still want meaningful lives rooted in faith and purpose.

Last year during our question-and-answer session at the Women's Leadership Summit, one young woman walked up to the microphone... and Charlie recognized her immediately.

Before she could even ask her question, Charlie's face lit up with a huge smile as he said, _" Hey! So... you're getting married!" _

The room burst into cheers as she smiled and nodded her head.

And then Charlie reminded everyone why he recognized her in the first place.

The year before, she had stood at the mic and asked him a simple question:

_" How do I meet a husband?" _

A year later, she came back to WLS engaged.

I smile thinking about how excited everyone in that room was for her.

I see moments like that every year at the Women's Leadership Summit. And after I leave, I always carry home a deep sense of hope about this next generation of young women.

Not because they have everything figured out.

But because so many of them are still searching for what is true, and for who God designed them to be.

Revival is not going to come through louder politicians or more influencers.

It's going to come through the living rooms of mothers who pray with their children, pray over their children, and love their husbands. And through bold actions of unshakeable devotion to Jesus Christ.

I believe the way a woman loves her family, raises her children, serves others, and walks with God leaves a mark on the world far greater than most people will ever realize.

That's why this event matters so deeply to me.

And when I think back on my own life, I know how true that is.

Before I met Charlie, I was not dreaming about marriage, motherhood, and building a family.

But when I met the right man, everything shifted. Everything changed.

And before doors open in San Antonio for the Women's Leadership Summit this June, I just want to thank you for helping make this event possible year after year.

Thank you for helping us continue pouring into these young women.

Thank you for helping carry forward a mission that changes so many lives -- including mine.

I truly cannot wait to see what God does through this next generation of young women.

In 2026, it's hard to believe that some politicians, even within my own party, are still trying to sell the exhausted promise of trickle-down economics. For decades, leaders in both parties made a calculated choice: they sided with corporate power and had the nerve to call it "centrism."
> | [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/3a1cfa80-a25e-485c-96a1-3dca7f5e8c4a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[CLICK HERE. BREAK THE MACHINE.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/f321941a-a1a3-4d04-b596-3ae4e6d5f2fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
They told us the wealth would eventually come back around. It didn't. It stayed at the top.
Let me be clear: this isn't about hating business. Small businesses are the backbone of Middle Tennessee. They are the ones creating the local jobs and keeping our neighborhoods alive, but there is a massive difference between supporting a local entrepreneur and letting a global corporation buy the rules and squeeze everyone else out.
If the "center" of our politics actually consisted of everyday Americans we would be making very different decisions. American families wouldn't be subsidizing drug costs for the rest of the world and policy wouldn't start with what a lobbyist wants; it would start with what a family needs.
**We can build a politics that puts everyday people at the center, not as an afterthought or a talking point, but as the starting line for every decision we make.**
**We have the momentum to flip this seat and change the system.[Please contribute $20 or $25 today to help us put people back at the center of the map.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/f321941a-a1a3-4d04-b596-3ae4e6d5f2fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Chip in Today!](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/f321941a-a1a3-4d04-b596-3ae4e6d5f2fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The choice is simple. We can keep protecting a broken system that serves the few, or we can stand up for the working families who just want a fair shot. I know where I stand. I hope you'll stand with me.

Mail-in voting is secure, legitimate, and essential for millions of Americans — including working parents, caregivers, seniors, voters with disabilities, members of the military, and people who simply can’t make it to the polls on Election Day. In fact, nearly one in three Americans voted by mail during the 2024 election — adding up to about _48 million_ votes.

And despite Trump’s years of attacks on mail-in voting — despite him calling it a “terrible thing” and falsely claiming it’s “rampant with fraud” — he has voted by mail _himself_ in multiple elections.

Because here’s the truth, Peter: Trump doesn’t actually have a problem with mail-in voting. He has a problem knowing that this November, voters will reject him, his MAGA cronies, and his corrupt agenda at the ballot box.

Whether people vote by mail, vote early in person, or vote at the polls on Election Day, Trump knows what’s coming. And now he’s trying to make it harder for millions of people to cast their ballots.

We can’t let him get away with it.

clean_body: We can’t let Trump end mail-in voting | = Have you seen this, Peter? = Just weeks after Trump signed an executive order targeting mail-in voting, the United States Postal Service is now moving forward with a plan to make his voter suppression agenda a reality. Trump knows his control of Congress is hanging by a thread. So instead of making life better for the American people, he’s doing what he always does: trying to rig the system to hold on to power. And EMILYs List women are fighting back. = | = Mail-in voting is secure, legitimate, and essential for millions of Americans — including working parents, caregivers, seniors, voters with disabilities, members of the military, and people who simply can’t make it to the polls on Election Day. In fact, nearly one in three Americans voted by mail during the 2024 election — adding up to about 48 million votes. And despite Trump’s years of attacks on mail-in voting — despite him calling it a “terrible thing” and falsely claiming it’s “rampant with fraud” — he has voted by mail himself in multiple elections. Because here’s the truth, Peter: Trump doesn’t actually have a problem with mail-in voting. He has a problem knowing that this November, voters will reject him, his MAGA cronies, and his corrupt agenda at the ballot box. Whether people vote by mail, vote early in person, or vote at the polls on Election Day, Trump knows what’s coming. And now he’s trying to make it harder for millions of people to cast their ballots. We can’t let him get away with it. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue, your donation will go through immediately: = | = ---|--- = | = = | = This is so important, Peter. body:
His latest accusations are, unsurprisingly, totally false.
# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=1470%2E1086043%2EFrKUBr)
Peter,
The President of the United States, who’s _never once_ worn a uniform or served our country overseas, has once again taken to Truth Social to spread lies about me.
His latest accusations are, unsurprisingly, totally false. But I find it ironic that Donald Trump wants to talk to me about caring about our veterans and servicemembers _as if he knows the first thing about service._
Only one of us has actually served. And it isn’t the one posting about golf courses.
This is not the first time Trump has attacked me from behind his keyboard. It probably won’t be the last. **[Can I count on you to have my back in this fight no matter what this President or any of our MAGA opponents throw our way? No matter what falsehoods Trump tries to spread about me, I will never lose sight of our mission to Leave No One Behind.

Today marks the 82nd anniversary of D-Day. On that day, more than 150,000 Allied troops stormed the beaches of Normandy in the largest amphibious invasion in history. Young men from across America, Britain, Canada, and beyond waded into machine-gun fire, knowing many would not return. They did it not for conquest, but to liberate a continent from tyranny and restore freedom, democracy, and collective security.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6f8ae368-796a-4a87-baf6-cbf818e13de8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
As I watch my kids grow up, I see a world that is increasingly unstable. My grandparent's generation understood something we seem to be forgetting: isolationism and protectionism don't keep us safe, they invite darkness.
**The Lessons of the Past**
Before Pearl Harbor, too many leaders in the free world had chosen isolationism and protectionism. They hoped the rising threats in Europe and Asia would burn themselves out if we just minded our own business. The result? A world war that cost over 400,000 American lives and tens of millions worldwide.
Out of the darkness, our ancestors forged alliances, and stood shoulder-to-shoulder with partners who shared our values. They understood that American strength (military, economic, and moral) is most effective when paired with solid leadership on the world stage. The post-war order they built prevented another great-power conflict for decades.
Today, we face echoes of that earlier darkness. Authoritarian regimes in Russia, China, Iran, and North Korea are testing the limits of the free world. Vladimir Putin's brutal war in Ukraine continues. China threatens Taiwan and dominates critical supply chains. Iran funds terrorism across the Middle East. These forces are actively working to tear apart the alliances and economic relationships that have kept the peace.
And yet, here at home, a growing chorus of protectionists and isolationists want us to turn inward once again.
**The Danger of "America Alone"**
We've seen the rhetoric: tariffs that act as taxes on American families and businesses, threats to abandon NATO, skepticism toward supporting allies who stand on the front lines of freedom. Their "America First" promise is shortsighted. They want to pull back, build walls, and to put "America First" in the narrowest sense.
**History and basic economics say they are dead wrong.**
Protectionist tariffs raise costs for American farmers, manufacturers, and working families who rely on affordable goods and export markets. Isolationism weakens our leverage, emboldens our adversaries, and leaves us more vulnerable, not less. When we step back, someone else steps forward, and it's never a friend of democracy or American values.
As an American who believes in working towards a better future for everyone, I reject the false choice between endless entanglement and total withdrawal. Strong national defense, smart alliances, and strategic engagement are common sense.
Our family business, VES Specialists, has served critical businesses, including manufacturing, trucking, and warehouse clients for 37 years. I know what happens when supply chains break down and uncertainty spikes prices. Businesses struggle to adapt. American families feel it at the pump, the grocery store, and the car dealership. A foreign policy that invites chaos fails to serve the American people.
**A Better Path Forward**
We don't need to repeat the mistakes of the 1930s. We need the moral clarity, smart policy, and strong leadership.
• **Stand by our allies.** A strong NATO deters Putin and shares the burden of defense.
• **Support strategic trade.** Fair agreements that open markets for American goods while protecting workers- not blanket tariffs that punish consumers.
• **Lead with strength and diplomacy.** Rebuild congressional authority over foreign policy. Restore trust with partners. Confront threats without rushing into unnecessary wars.
• **Remember who we are.** The United States is exceptional not because we hide from the world, but because our example and engagement have repeatedly pulled the world back from the brink.
On this D-Day anniversary, let's honor the fallen and the veterans who are still with us. Many American families have stories of relatives who hit those beaches fighting for freedom. Their sacrifice bought us decades of relative peace and prosperity. We owe it to them, and to our children, to defend that inheritance.
America is stronger when we engage the world with confidence, common sense, and a firm rejection of the extremes that play into dangerous, out-of-control populism.
**Let 's learn from the past, and build a better future.**
Thank y'all for standing with me,
Kyle

Hi Peter,
it’s Andy Levin, former Congressman for Michigan’s 9th district.

personal with you.

In 2022, I ran for re-election to Congress, and AIPAC spent millions of
dollars that came mostly from Republican billionaires to defeat me in a
Democratic primary! They were threatened by our people-powered campaign
that challenged corporate and dark money influence in our politics.

Unfortunately, we came up short, but the movement we built didn’t
disappear.

I’ve continued organizing — because the fight to build a government that
prioritizes people over profit is the cause of our lives.

Now, those same forces are targeting Michigan’s Senate race. AIPAC will
spend whatever it takes to stop a truth-telling candidate like Abdul.

That’s why I’m backing Abdul and endorsing his campaign. [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260606-2-ak.802WJz&amount=10&refcode=em20260606-2313&t=1006&akid=2327%2E251025%2Eo7LjJf ]Will you join

competitive primary by chipping in $10 today?

Peter, if we
want our next senator to be someone who fights for working people, for
healthcare, for clean water, and for a democracy not controlled by
billionaire interests, Abdul is the best candidate for the job.

He’s the only candidate in this race who has never taken money from
corporate PACs or AIPAC, and never will. That means we can trust him to
fight for our best interests, but it also means he needs us to fuel this
campaign.

I know firsthand what it looks like when dark money groups try to buy an
election. Abdul is facing that on an even bigger scale.

But Abdul can win this race. He’s leading in the polls, he’s built a real
coalition, and he has the moral courage we desperately need in this
moment. This movement just has to show up for him.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260606-2-ak.802WJz&amount=10&refcode=em20260606-2313&t=1008&akid=2327%2E251025%2Eo7LjJf ]So I’m asking — organizer to organizer, neighbor to neighbor — will you
support Abdul’s campaign by contributing $10 or anything you

Solidarity,

Andy Levin

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Reuters: US Postal Service seeks to require states to submit lists of voters [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA007/1/89215/images/Reuters_USPSBallotList.png]
Keeping this one short because it's urgent, Folks.
One day after a federal judge declined to immediately block President Donald Trump's executive order suppressing mail-in voting, the U.S. Postal Service proposed new rules would require states to provide lists of voters utilizing mail-in voting and not deliver ballots to anyone not listed.
This impacts voters two ways: First, it requires states to submit voter data to the federal government despite the Constitution saying states control voting. Second, it would empower the USPS to withhold delivery of a ballot you requested from your state.
Simply put -- we have no idea what Trump and his team are going to do with the data they receive from states, and they've made no promises to honor the integrity of those lists and not try and remove people they don't think should vote by mail. We must voice our disapproval of this plan immediately!

**_[Today, I’m humbly asking you for your endorsement if you believe I’m the greatest President our country has ever seen.>](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)_**

President Donald J. Trump __

The tequila was real, the Wi-Fi was not, and somewhere over the Atlantic Delta Airlines scrambled Cliff's computer so thoroughly that this week's Tequila Talk opened in glorious technological chaos. It only got better from there. Cliff--fresh off a red-eye from Sicily--and our favorite recovering Republican Joe Walsh poured a couple of drinks and went somewhere real. It's funny, it's furious, and it's the kind of unscripted cross-aisle conversation you don't get anywhere else. A taste of where they went:
1\. **The night everything broke.** Delta fried Cliff's machine somewhere over the Atlantic, and the meltdown opened onto a question neither of them could shake.
2\. **The AI stat that should keep you up at night.** There's one number in Lawrence's Blue Amp piece that's enough to ruin your evening. Cliff says it out loud.
3\. **Bread, circuses, and a fight on the South Lawn.** Why Cliff thinks the spectacle on the White House lawn is lifted straight from the last days of Rome.
4\. **The predator class, then and now.** Gladiator, an emperor's island, and a through-line to today's headlines you won't be able to unsee.
5\. **Empire on its last legs, or a wake-up call?** Joe makes the case for why all of this might--somehow--be the good news.
6\. **Obama 's bad take. **One quote set Cliff off, and it turned into a reckoning with the party's own leadership.
7\. **The Democrats who actually fight.** A short list of names Cliff will go to the mat for. Worth seeing whether yours made it.
8\. **The party 's "Tea Party moment." **Where the anger goes next, and the point at which it curdles into something darker.
9\. **Antisemitism, Israel, and the test of consistency.** The most charged stretch of the night--the line Joe won't cross, and the one "tell" Cliff watches for.
10\. **And a few things you 'll want to see to believe. **A missing drug, a viral buffalo, an unlikely court brief, and Cliff's flat-out prediction for Ohio.
Plus a look at the week ahead. Watch the full conversation, then come find us in the comments.
